v: Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj rey Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a chonhab' Moab t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.

Ay jun k'u ix kot sutnaj winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat t'a Samaria. Te niwan ix aj winh slajwi, yuj chi' ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winh yik b'at sk'anb'ej yab' heb' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal heb' aj Ecrón, tato olto b'oxok winh.

Palta a jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe icha tik: Ixik, b'at cha heb' schekab' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Samaria, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a ko chonhab' a onh israel onh tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón sb'at he k'anb'ej eyab'i? xa chi t'a heb'.

Tzalanpaxi to a in Jehová in swal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol ach k'e wa'an, palta ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi'. Ix b'at winhaj Elías chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha tas ix alji chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' schekab' winh rey chi', ix k'ochxi heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj ix ex meltzaj t'a elanhchamel? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb': --Mamin rey, ay jun winh winak ix ko cha t'a yol b'e. Ha winh ix halan t'ayonh icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'a winh ix ex chekankot chi', tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a Israel tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón tza chekb'at ab'chajok? Yuj wal jun tas ix a na' tik, manhxo ol ach k'e wa'an, ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xe chi, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji jun winh ix halan chi' t'ayex? xchi winh.

--Mamin rey, a jun winh chi' ayoch jun pichul ay xi'il yuj winh, aypaxoch jun tzek'ul tz'u'um t'a snanhal winh, xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at jun winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50 heb' winh soldado yik b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Elías chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh, k'ojanem winh t'a jun tzalan. Ix yalan winh capitán chi' t'a winh: --Ach schekab' Dios, a winh rey ix alankoti to tzach emta, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak', ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Elías chi': --Ach schekab' Dios, emanhkot t'a elanhchamel yal winh rey, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Tato schekab' in Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh a soldado chi', xchi winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak' t'a satcha'anh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado t'a yoxelal. Palta a jun winh capitán chi', ix k'ek'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elías chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ak' wal niwank'olal t'a wib'anh yet' 50 heb' winh soldado a chekab' tik.

Yujto a juntzanh heb' winh capitán yet' soldado, heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayach, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh yuj k'ak' ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ha in tik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yik max onh chami, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ixik yet' winh, manh ach xiwok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emta winhaj Elías chi', ix b'at winh yet' winh capitán chi', ix b'at winh yil winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh rey chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Yujto ix a chekb'at heb' a chekab' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón, yik b'at a k'anb'ej a b'a, ichato malaj Dios t'a Israel tik b'aj syal tza k'anb'ej ab'i, yuj chi' manhxo ol ach k'e wa'an, palta to ol ach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Icha chi' ix aji, ix cham winh rey chi', icha tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Elías chi'. Yujto malaj junok yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi', yuj chi' a jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Joram, a winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, haton yik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch junxo winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Ocozías yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik toxo wal sk'och sk'uhal yik'jib'at winhaj Elías yuj Jehová t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik', ix el winh yet' winhaj Eliseo t'a Gilgal.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Betel, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a Betel chi'.

Ix elta heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Betel chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to a tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Jericó, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a Jericó chi'.

Ix eltapax heb' winh schekab' Dios ayek' ta' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to a tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a ha' Jordán, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej heb' winh schawanhil.
Najat ix b'at tzak'an 50 heb' winh schekab' Dios yuj heb' winh, najatto ix kan heb' winh t'a yichanhkot heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.
Ixlajwi chi' ix spakan jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi', ix spajanem winh t'a sat ha' Jordán chi'. Ix spojan sb'a ha', takinh ix aj b'aj ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol ha' chi'.

Ayik toxo ix k'axpaj ek' heb' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas tza nib'ej swak' t'ayach yakb'an manto in ik'jokel t'a a tz'ey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Tzin k'an t'ayach to cha makan tz'aj ak'ankan opisio chi' t'ayin, ichato a b'ab'el unin tzin ajkan a k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': Te ajaltak jun tza k'an tik t'ayin. Tato ol il tas ol aj wik'jiel t'a a tz'ey, ol ak'jok t'ayach. Tato manh ol il jun, manh ol ak'joklaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, wan slolon heb' winh. Elanhchamel ix cheklajk'e jun carruaje k'ak' yilji, tok'b'il yuj nok' chej k'ak' yiljipaxi. A' ix ik'anel winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik'.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh. Manhxa b'aj ix yil winhaj Elías winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix snhik'chitanb'at jun spichul winhaj Eliseo ayoch yuj yik sch'oxanel skusk'olal winh.
Elanhchamel ix b'at winh sik'k'e jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías ix kan lanhnaj chi'. Ix meltzajkan winh t'a ha' Jordán chi', ix och linhan winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ix spajanem sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' winh t'a sat ha ha' chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ayek' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Elías? xchi winh. Ixnhej em k'apak chi' t'a sat ha', ix spojan sb'a ha'. Icha chi' ix aj yek'xita winh t'a yol ha'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Jericó, haton heb' winh najat linhjab'kan yila', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha yopisio winhaj Elías ix ochkan t'a winhaj Eliseo tik, xchi heb' winh. Ix kot heb' scha winh, ix em nhojnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, iltonab'i, ay 50 heb' winh winak t'a ko kal tik te tek'an. Tato syal a k'ol sb'at heb' winh say winh a k'ayb'umal chi', talaj ay b'aj ix aktajkan winh yuj Yespíritu Jehová t'a jolomtak witz, ma t'a yoltak ch'olan, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Palta ix yalan winh: --Ma'ay, malaj mach sb'ati, xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ixikek an, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh 50 chi' say t'a oxe' k'uhal. Malaj mach ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jericó b'aj aykan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayex jun to max ex b'atlaj? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ilnab' wal yilji jun lugar tik, te wach', palta malaj tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um yujto manh wach'ok ha ha' ay t'a lu'um, xchi heb'.
--Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot atz'am atz'am t'a yol junok uk'ab' ak'to, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun uk'ab' atz'am chi' heb' t'a winh,

ix b'at sekanem winh t'a yol sjaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha in ix in b'o jun ha ha' tik. Manhxa b'ak'inh ay mach ol cham yuj ha', manhxa pax b'ak'inh malaj tas ol yak' t'a sat lu'um yuj ha', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'okan ha', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Betel. Ayik wan sk'e winh t'a sb'e'al chi', ay jun nhilanh heb' winh kelemtak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' ix elta t'a yol sb'e winh, ix och ijan heb' winh sb'ajan winh, ix yalan heb' winh: K'e'anh ach t'en jolom. K'e'anh ach t'en jolom, xchi heb' winh.

Ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a heb' winh, ix katab'aj heb' winh yuj winh t'a sb'i Jehová. Elanhchamel ix elta chawanh nok' oso t'a kaltak te', ix kotak nhik'chitajb'at 42 heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, ix meltzajxi winh t'a Samaria.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'och wal ijan chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh yik smam snun. Yujto ix sjuel jun k'e'en k'e'en winh yik Baal sb'onakkan winh smam winh chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ix sb'eyb'alejnhej schukal b'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Ha winhaj Mesa sreyal Moab, molum kalnel winh yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Yuj chi' a nok' syak' winh yik stupan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', 100 mil nok' yunetak kalnel yet' pax 100 mil nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' slana'il syak' winh.
Palta ayik ix cham winhaj Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a winh sreyal Moab chi' t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.
Yuj chi', ix el winhaj Joram t'a Samaria, ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh.

Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá: Ha winh sreyal Moab toxo ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh in mandar, ¿tzam yal a k'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' winh? xchib'at winh. Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Judá chi' icha tik: Ol in b'at het'ok yet' heb' in soldado yet' nok' in chej.
Anhej b'i'an, ¿tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joram chi' ix yalan winh: Ha t'a sb'e'al takinh lu'um t'a yol yik Edom, hata' ol onh b'atok, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winh sreyal Israel yet' winh sreyal Judá yet' pax winh sreyal Edom yet' heb' soldado. Uke' k'uhal ix b'ey heb' yujto ix ek' yoymitej lum takinh lum chi' heb', yuj chi' ix lajwiel ha' ya'al heb' soldado syuk'ej yet' pax yik masanil snok' heb' yet'nak.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ichato onh smolb'ej Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Moab tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová ayek' t'a tik yik wach' sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová ku'uj? xchi winh. Ay jun winh yajal soldado yaj t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix tak'wi icha tik: --Ha t'a tik ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Haton winh schekab'kan winhaj Elías, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh chi' yel schekab' Jehová yaj winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at oxwanh heb' winh rey chi' lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas walan wik t'ayach? Ixik, b'at k'anb'ej a b'a t'a heb' winh schekab' sdiosalkan heb' a mam a nun, xchi winh. Palta ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi': --Ma'ay, yujto onh ik'jikot yuj Jehová a onh oxwanh rey onh tik, yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' moabita, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --T'a wal yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swala', haton jun swak' serwil, k'inalok malaj yelk'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá tik t'a yol in sat, manh jab'ok tzin cha wab' tas tzala', max in ochpax k'elan jab'ok t'ayach.

Ik'ekkot junok mach syal schalan te' arpa t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun winh syal schalan te' arpa chi' heb' winh. Ayik wan schalan te' arpa chi' winh, ix jawi yipalil Jehová t'a winhaj Eliseo chi',
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: B'o'ek tzijtumok sanja t'a jun ch'olan tik.
Wach'chom malaj ik', ma nhab' ol eyil sjawi, palta a jun ch'olan tik ol b'ut'jok yuj ha ha', yuj chi' he masanil ol eyuk' ha', ol yuk'an ha' nok' he wakax yet' pax nok' he chej, xchi Jehová.
Chekelnhej wal yaj jun tik t'a yichanh tas ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol yak'och heb' moabita chi' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Yuj chi' ol he juem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' wach' yajoch smuro'al yet' juntzanh niwak chonhab' wach' yilji. Ol he ch'akanem masanil yawb'en te' heb', ol laj he mukankan sjaj ha' yuk'lab' ha' heb', ol he b'ut'ankan sat slum heb' yet' k'e'en k'e'en b'aj smunlaji, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ha t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, icha yora'il tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová, ha t'a yol yik Edom, ix kot ha ha', ix b'ut'jiel sat lum lum chi' yuj ha'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' moabita to wan sk'och heb' winh rey yak' owal yet' heb', ix smolb'an masanil heb' winh kelemtak heb' yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh syal yoch t'a owal, ix och heb' winh smak t'a sat smojon snación chi'.
Ayik ix k'e wan heb' moabita chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix yilan heb' toxonhej skopopi yilji yib'anh ha ha' chi' yuj yok k'u, ichato chik'xonhej yilji ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha jun chi' chik'. Tope a heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh soldado ix smil-lajcham sb'a. Ha tikne'ik koyek sb'at kik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ix kani, xchi heb'.

Palta haxo ix jawi heb' moabita t'a scampamento heb' israel, ix elta heb' israel chi' yak' owal yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar heb' moabita chi' yuj heb'. Yuj chi' ix el heb' elelal, palta ix och heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb', ix miljicham heb' yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sjuanem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' moabita chi' heb', ix sb'ut'an lum lum heb' t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton lum te yax sat yik munlajel. Ix smukan sjajtak ha ha' heb', ix sch'akanel masanil te' awb'en te' heb' te wach'. Haxonhej chonhab' Quir-hareset ixto kani, palta haxo heb' sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejme'ech, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ayik ix yilan winh sreyal Moab to wan yak'ji ganar winh t'a owal chi', ix yik'ankot 700 heb' soldado winh, heb' te jelan yak'an owal yet' k'e'en espada. Ix yekanoch sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' soldado yik sk'och heb' b'aj ayek' winh sreyal Edom chi', yik smilancham winh heb' yalani, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh sreyal Moab chi', haton jun t'inhan yochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix snhusantz'a winh silab'il t'a sdiosal t'a yib'anh smuro'al schonhab' chi'. Te chuk ix aj sna'an heb' winh israel chi' yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix yik'k'e wa'an scampamento heb' winh, ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.

Ay jun ix ix yetb'eyumkan junok heb' winh schekab' Dios, ix b'at ix yal sb'a t'a winhaj Eliseo icha tik: --Ha winh wetb'eyum chamnakxo winh, ojtak to te ay xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Haxo tikne'ik ay jun winh ak'annak k'e'en tumin smajnej winh wetb'eyum chi', ix jawi winh t'ayin, snib'ej winh syik'b'at chawanh heb' wune' tik schekab'ok yuj k'e'en tumin chi', xchi ix.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tza nib'ej tzin b'o t'ayach? Al t'ayin tastak ay t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in a chekab' in tik, malaj wal jab'ok tas ay t'ayin, anhej wal jab' yune' xalu aceite ayek' t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixik, tza k'anan a majnej jantak xalu t'a heb' ay t'a a lak'anil, jantaknhej malaj yo'ol tz'ilchaj u'uj.

Elanhchamel tzach och t'a yol a pat yet' heb' winh une' chi'. Tza makan a pat chi', tzak'an b'ut'jok masanil juntzanh yet'tal chi' t'a aceite chi'. Ch'ok b'aj tzak'kanem juntzanh sb'ut'jikan chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon ix yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at smakanoch sb'a ix yet' heb' winh yune' chi' t'a yol spat, ix syamanoch heb' sb'ut'an juntzanh xalu ix smajnej chi' t'a aceite chi'.

Ayik toxo ix b'ut'ji masanil xalu chi', ix yalan ix t'a junok heb' winh yune' chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot junokxo xalu, xchi ix. Ix yalan jun winh yune' ix chi': --Manhxalaj tas, xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix wanaj aceite chi' yeli.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'at ix yal t'a winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a ix: --Ha tikne'ik ixik a chonh aceite chi', slajwi chi' tza tupan a b'ok chi', haxo jantak stojol chi' skani, tza k'an k'e'en yet' heb' winh une' chi', xchi winh t'a ix.

Ay jun k'u ix ek' winhaj Eliseo t'a chonhab' Sunem. Hata' ay jun ix ix te b'eyum. Ix och tean ix t'a winh to tzek' winh wa'el t'a spat ix. Yuj chi' ayik tzek' winh juntak el t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzek'nhej winh wa'el t'a spat ix chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, snachajel wu'uj to a jun winh tzek'nhej onh yil t'a juntak el, wal yel schekab' Dios yaj winh.
Yuj chi', wach' sko b'o junok cuarto t'a yib'anh ko pat tik, skak'anoch junok ch'at t'a yo'ol, junok mexa, junok xila yet' junok candil, yik wach' ayik sjawi winh onh yila', hata' skan winh, xchi ix.
Ix ek'xi winhaj Eliseo chi' ta' yet' winh schekab' skuchan Giezi, ix k'e heb' winh t'a yol jun cuarto chi', hata' ix waykan heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi' icha tik: --Awtej ix aj Sunem chi', xchi winh. Ix yawtan ix winh, ix jawi ix t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi':

--k'anb'ej t'a ix tas snib'ej sk'ol ix, yujto te wach' syutej sk'ol ix t'ayonh. Tato syal sk'ol ix syal tzonh lolon yet' winh rey yuj ix, ma yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix: --Ma'ay, wach' waj t'a yol in chonhab' tik, xchi ix t'a winh chekab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax ix.
--¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej t'a ix syal chi'? xchi winh t'a winh schekab' chi'. --Max nachajel wu'uj, anhej, malaj yune' ix, haxo winh yetb'eyum ix icham winakxo winh, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.
--Awtejxikot ix, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix awtajxikot ix, ix jawi tek'tek' ix t'a spuerta'il jun cuarto chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix: --Yab' wal icha tik junab', chelb'ilxo k'e junok une' u'uj, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ma'ay mamin, ach schekab' Dios, manh ach b'uchwaj t'ayin, xchi ix.
Palta ix skuchanoch jun yune' ix, haxo t'a junxo ab'il, ix alji jun yune' ix chi', icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Ix k'ib' jun unin chi', ay jun k'u ix b'at yil winh smam b'aj ayb'at yil heb' sjochum trigo.

Ix yalan jun unin chi' t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Ay, te ya in jolom. Te ya in jolom, xchi. Ix yalan winh mamab'il chi' t'a junok heb' winh schekab': --Ik'b'at winh unin tik t'a ix snun, xchi winh.
Ix ik'jib'at winh unin chi' t'a ix snun yuj winh chekab' chi', ix schelank'e ix t'a sat xub', haxo ix och chimk'uhalil ix chami.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'ankanek' telan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix smakankan jun cuarto chi' ix.
Elanhchamel ix yawtej winh yetb'eyum ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Chekb'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' yet' junok nok' b'uru wet'ok, sb'at wilan winh schekab' Dios, naktik in jaxi, xchi ix.
--¿Tas yuj b'at il winh tikne'ik? Manh stiempo'alok yalji k'e'en uj, manh sk'uhalok pax ik'oj ip, xchi winh yetb'eyum ix chi'. --Manh ak' pensar, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix to tz'ak'jioch stz'u'um nok' b'uru chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh schekab' chi': --Konh an, yelk'olal a pechan nok', manh a cha och wa'an nok' t'a yol b'e masanto a in ol wal t'ayach, xchi ix t'a winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix masanto ix k'och ix t'a lum witz Carmelo b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi'. Najatto wan skot ix ix yilanb'at winh, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Giezi icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a ix aj Sunem sjawi chi'.
Ixik b'at cha ix, tza k'anb'an t'a ix tato wach' sk'ol ix yet' winh yetb'eyum yet' winh nene' unin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh scha ix. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix, ix yalan ix to wach' sk'ol heb'.

Palta elanhchamel ix k'och ix b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo t'a lum witz Carmelo chi', ix och lak'naj ix t'a yok winh, haxo winhaj Giezi chi' ix ketzanel ix yalani. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aktejel ix, yujto te kusnak spixan ix swila', manta tas syal Jehová t'ayin tas yuj ix kot ix, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tokwal a in ix in k'an t'ayach to tz'alji junok wune'? ¿Tom maj wal t'ayach tas yuj tonhej tzach b'uchwaj t'ayin? xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a winh schekab' chi': --Ak' lista a b'a, ik'b'at te' in k'okoch tik het'ok, tzach b'at t'a elanhchamel. Tato ay mach tza cha'a, manh ach lolon yet'ok. Tato ay heb' tz'awajkot t'ayach, manh ach tak'wok t'a heb'. Ayik tzach k'och chi' tzak'em te' in k'okoch tik t'a sat winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix snun winh unin chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to max in b'at t'a tik tato max ach b'at wet'ok, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' ix. Haxo pax winhaj Giezi chi', toxo ix b'ab'lajb'at winh, toxo ix yak'em te' k'okoch chi' winh t'a sat winh unin chi', palta maj jaxlaj sk'ol winh. Yuj chi' ix kot winh scha winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Max jalaj sk'ol winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Eliseo t'a yol cuarto chi', telanek' winh unin chi' t'a sat sch'at winh, chamnakxo.
Yuj chi' ix och winh t'a yol jun cuarto chi' sch'okoj yet' winh unin chi', ix smakan winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e winh t'a sat ch'at chi', ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix em tenan sat winh t'a sat winh unin chi', ix yak'anoch sti' winh t'a sti' yet' sk'ab' winh t'a sk'ab'. Ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi'. Ix k'ixnajxi sniwanil winh unin chi'.

Ix el winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix ek' b'esesok winh t'a yol pat chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ex lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal. Haxo ix aj jun, ukel ix at'iswi winh unin chi', ichato chi' ix elta k'elan winh.

Ix yawtan winhaj Giezi winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Awtejkot ix sunamita chi', xchi winh. Ix b'at winh yawtejkot ix. Haxo ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi' jun, ix yalan winh: --Ina winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix snitzanoch sb'a ix, ix em kuman ix t'a yichanh winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schelank'e winh yune' ix chi', ix elta ix t'a yol scuarto winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Gilgal ayik te ayem jun niwan wejel t'a yol yik Israel. Ha junel molanoch heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: Ak'k'e junok niwan chen t'a yib'anh k'ak', tza b'oan swa'el heb' winh schekab' Dios tik, xchi winh.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chekab' chi' ix b'at sayoj itaj. Ix ilchaj jun anh itaj icha anh kaltakte'al k'um ay sat yuj winh. Ix smolankot sat chi' winh t'a yol jun spichul jukan. Haxo yik ix jax winh, ix slesanem winh t'a yol jun niwan chen chi', palta manh yojtakok winh tas.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix syamanoch heb' winh swa'i, ix el yaw heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, a jun wan ko chi'an tik ayb'at veneno t'a skal, xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo schilaj heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot jab'ok ixim harina t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yak'anem ixim winh t'a yol chen chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik ak' wa heb' anima tik, xchi winh. Haxo ix schi'an heb', manhxalaj tas ix ik'an heb'.

Haxo t'a junel ix k'och jun winh winak aj Baal-salisa, yet'nak 20 ixim pan cebada winh b'ob'il t'a ixim b'ab'el sat cebada chi', ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', yet'nakpax ixim jolom trigo winh yaxto. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh schekab': --Ak' ixim pan chi' swa heb' anima tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh schekab' winh chi': --¿Tokwal ol yal wak'an jab' tik t'a 100 anima tik? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ak' wa heb' anima tik, yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to ol wa heb', aytopax ol kanok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an wa heb' anima chi' winh chekab' chi'. Ayto ix kani, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ay jun winh winak skuch Naamán, yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Siria. Te xajan winh yuj winh rey chi', te niwan pax yelk'och winh, yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'ol t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Te jelan winh t'a owal, palta ayoch jun yab'il lepra t'a winh.
Ay junel, ay juntzanh heb' soldado aj Siria ix b'at elk'al t'a yol yik Israel. Ix yelk'ejb'at jun ix kob'es unin heb'. Ix och ix schekab'ok ix yetb'eyum winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix yalan ix kob'es unin chi' t'a ix b'aj ayoch chekab'ok chi': --Komonok sb'at winh in patrón tik t'a jun winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Samaria, talaj sb'oxi winh yuj jun yab'il tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yal t'a winh sreyal Siria tas ix yal ix kob'es chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Wach' tzach b'ati, swak'b'at junok carta t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj Naamán chi', ix yik'anb'at nanhal swajxakil quintal k'e'en plata winh yet' nanhal schab'il quintal k'e'en oro yet' lajunh moj pichul.

Ix yik'anb'at jun carta chi' winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', syalan winh sreyal Siria chi' t'a jun carta chi' icha tik: Ayik ol a cha'an in carta tik, ol ojtakejeli to a in tzin chekb'at winh sat yajal heb' in soldado skuchan Naamán tik t'ayach, tzanhtej winh t'a jun lepra ayoch t'ay, xchi winh t'a scarta chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi yilan jun carta chi' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxaneli to tz'och winh t'a ilk'olal, ix yalan winh: --Tokwal Dios in, ¿tom a in syal wak'an schamel anima, ma swak'anpax sk'inal heb', yuj chi' schekjikot jun winh winak tik t'ayin yik swik'el jun lepra tik t'a winh? Syalelk'ochi to ay tas sna' winh rey chi' t'a in patik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios to ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh rey chi', ix yalanb'at winh: --¿Tas yuj ix a nhik'chitejb'at a pichul? Chekkot jun winh chi' t'ayin, ol yilan winh to ay schekab' Dios t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchib'at winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yet' scarruaje yet' schej yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, ix k'och linhan heb' t'a sti' spat winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix schekanb'at winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: Ixik, b'at b'ikel ukelok a b'a t'a ha' Jordán, icha chi' ol aj yel yab'il lepra chi' t'a a niwanil chi', xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Naamán chi', ix b'at winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha wal in na'ani to ol elta winh in scha'a, ol k'e wal linhan winh slesalwi t'a Jehová sDiosal t'a wichanh, ol yak'anek' sk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch lepra chi' t'ayin, tz'elkan yab'il walani.

¿Tok ek'b'al swach'il junok ha' ay t'a Israel tik t'a yichanh ha' Abana yet' ha' Farfar ay t'a Damasco? ¿Tom max yal b'at in b'ikanel in b'a t'a yol ha' chi', tzin b'oxi? xchi winh. Te aykot yowal winh, ix meltzaj winh.

Palta haxo heb' schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, k'inalok ay junok tas ajaltak ix yal winh schekab' Dios t'ayach, ¿tom max a k'anab'ajej? Okxo jun, anhej ix yal winh to tza b'ikel a b'a tzach b'oxikani, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ichato chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi', ukel ix em winh t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios. Ix b'oxikan sniwanil winh chi', icha sniwanil junok unin, te wach' ix ajkani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' ajun yet' chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ix nachajel wu'uj to malaj junokxo Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta anhej wal he Diosal a ex israel ex tik. Yuj chi', elokab' t'a a k'o'ol a cha'an in silab' swak' tik t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová, haton ayin schekab', max in chalaj tas tzak' chi', xchi winh. Wach'chom ix ochnhej tean winhaj Naamán chi' t'a winh, palta maj schalaj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Tato icha chi' jun, elok wal t'a a k'o'ol a cha'an wik'b'at chab'ok chejal lum lum yik Israel tik, yujto a in a chekab' in tik, manhxa junokxo Dios b'aj ol wak' in silab', palta to anhej t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Anhej wal jun tzin k'an t'a Jehová to tzin yak' niwank'olal, yujto ayik ol b'at winh in reyal yak'em sb'a t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Rimón, ol och ketzketz winh t'a in k'ab', hanhejtona' ol in em kuman yet' winh t'a templo chi', yak'okab' niwank'olal Jehová t'a in patik yuj jun chi', xchi winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ak' pensar, ixik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi'. Palta kenanto sb'at winh,

ix sna'an winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi': ¿Tas yuj tonhej ix schab'at winhaj Naamán aj Siria winh wajalil tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix yak'kan winh? Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová to b'at in tzak'wej winh, yalnhej tas ol wik'ek' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Giezi chi'. Haxo ix yilankot winhaj Naamán to wan skot winh t'a spatik, ix emta winh t'a yol scarruaje, ix kot winh scha winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Mantok ay tas ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Giezi chi' icha tik: Ma'ay, malaj tasi, palta a winh wajalil ix in chekankot wal t'ayach to hato wal sk'och chawanh heb' kelemtak schekab' Dios spetoj t'a tzalkixtak yik Efraín. Yuj chi' sk'an winh t'ayach to tzak' oxeok arroba k'e'en plata yet' cha mojanhok k'apak pichul yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Naamán chi': --Komonok tz'el t'a a k'o'ol tza cha wal wakeok arroba k'e'en plata tik, xchi winh. Yakb'an wan yalan winh chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajem k'e'en yet' cha moj k'apak pichul chi' t'a yol chab' koxtal, ix yak'ankot chawanh schekab' winh yet' winhaj Giezi chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a tzalan b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yik'an ek' winhaj Giezi tastak yet'nak heb' schekab' winhaj Naamán chi', ix sk'ub'ankanel winh t'a yol spat, ix schekan meltzaj heb' winh.
Elanhchamel ix jawi winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Giezi, ¿b'ajtil ix ach xit'ek'i? xchi winh. --Malaj b'aj ix in xit'ek' mamin, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ayik ix emta jun winh winak t'a yol scarruaje ix kot winh ul ach scha'a, ¿tokwal maj yil in pixan jun chi' tza na'a? Ha tikne'ik, manh smojok ko cha'an tumin yet' pichul. Manh smojok pax ko manan te' awb'en te', icha te' olivo yet' te' uwa, nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax, ma heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab'.

Yuj jun tas ix a k'ulej tik, a tikne'ik, a slepra winhaj Naamán chi' ol ochkan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, xchi winh. Haxo yik ix spukan sb'a winhaj Giezi yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ayxo lepra t'a winh, sakxonhej yilji sniwanil winh icha k'e'en che'ew.
Ay junel ix yal heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Eliseo: --Ina wal jun lugar b'aj ayonh ek' et' tik, te lot'an.
Yuj chi' tzok wal el t'a a k'o'ol tzonh a chab'at t'a sti' ha' Jordán, sb'at ko ch'ak junjunok ko te', sko b'oank'e junok pat b'aj tzonh aji, xchi heb' winh. --Ixikek, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
--Tzok yal a k'o'ol tzach b'at ket'ok, xchi jun winh t'a winh. --Hinye, ol in b'atok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yet' heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán ch'akoj te' chi'.

Ayik wan sch'akan te' heb' winh, ay jun winh ix elta surnaj k'e'en sch'akab', ix b'atkan k'e'en t'a yol ha ha' chi', ix el yaw winh: --Ach in k'ayb'umal. Ha jun k'e'en ch'akab' tik hierro k'e'en, in majanpax k'e'en, xchi winh.

--¿B'ajtil ix b'at k'e'en? xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix sch'oxan winh b'aj ix b'at k'e'en chi'. Ix xikanelta jun te te' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yak'anem te' winh t'a yol ha', ix k'eul b'akhnaj k'e'en ch'akab' chi' t'a sat ha'.
--Ik'k'eta k'e'en, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anem sk'ab' winh, ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en winh.
Ha winh sreyal Siria ayoch owal yuj winh t'a Israel, ix slajtian sb'a winh yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado smasanil b'ajtil sb'ok'e scampamento heb' winh.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Eliseo t'a winh sreyal Israel b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh aj Siria chi' yik wach' syak' lista sb'a winh b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix schekanpaxb'at yilumal winh sreyal Israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj syal winh schekab' Dios chi', yik syil heb' winh tas yaji, yuj chi' tzijtum el ix skol sb'a heb' winh.

Ha winh sreyal Siria chi', ix te somchaj spensar winh, yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' winh yajalil soldado winh, ix yalan winh: --Alek t'ayin mach junok t'a ko kal tik ayoch yet' winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh yajal soldado icha tik: --Malaj mach mamin, palta a winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios ayek' t'a Israel chi', a winh tz'alan t'a winh rey masanil tas tzala', wach'chom t'a elk'altak tzala', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Siria chi': --Ixikek, b'at ilek b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ol wak'anb'at jaywanhok in soldado yik b'at tzek'jikot winh, xchi winh. Haxo ix aj yalji t'a winh rey chi' to ha t'a Dotán ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at jun nhilanh heb' winh soldado winh yet' heb' winh ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' carruaje yik owal. T'ak'walil ix k'och heb' winh t'a Dotán chi', ix yoyan sb'a heb' winh t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix sakb'i, ix k'e wa'an winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayik ix elta winh, ix yilan winh to manhxo jantakok soldado oyanek' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ay nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yal t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ay mamin, ¿tas wal ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ach xiwok, yujto ek'alto sb'isul heb' ayek' ket'ok t'a yichanh heb' winh chi', xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj Eliseo chi' slesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza jak sat winh in chekab' tik, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat winh chekab' chi' yuj Jehová, ix yilan winh to ha t'a sattak witz yet' t'a jolomtak witz, toxonhej oyankot soldado t'a yib'anh chej yet' t'a yoltak carruaje nab'a k'ak', oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ayik wan sjawi heb' winh sirio chi' yak' owal, ix sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Jehová: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza mak sat heb' winh tik, xchi winh. Haxo Jehová ix makan sat heb' winh soldado ajk'ol chi', icha ix aj sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a heb' winh: --Manhoklaj jun b'e yet' jun chonhab' tik tze saya'. Ochanhek tzak'an wu'uj, ol ex wik'b'at b'aj ayek' jun winh tze say chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a Samaria.

Ayik toxo ix och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, jak sat heb' winh yik syal yilan heb' winh, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat heb' winh chi'. Ix yilan heb' winh to ha t'a yol chonhab' Samaria ayek' heb' winh.
Ayik ix yilan heb' winh chi' winh sreyal Israel, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Mamin, ¿tzam yal in milancham heb' winh tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ma'ay, manh a milchamlaj heb' winh. K'inalok ay heb' syamchaj u'uj t'a owal, ¿tom tza milcham heb'? Ak' wa heb' winh, tzak'an yuk' ha' heb' winh, tzak'an meltzaj heb' winh t'a winh yajalil, xchi winh.

Ix b'o jun niwan wa'el, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh sreyal Israel to spax heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh b'aj ayek' winh yajalil chi'. Atax ta' ix yaktej heb' winh soldado sirio yochta yik syixtan chonhab' Israel yet' yochta heb' elk'al.
Ixlajwi yek' jun pekti', a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix molb'ej masanil heb' winh soldado winh, ix b'at yoyank'e Samaria heb' winh yik syak'an owal yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix em jun niwan wejel t'a Samaria chi'. Ix te k'e stojol masanil tastak, yujto te wach' yajoch hoyan heb' winh aj Siria chi' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'. Ha junok sjolom nok' b'uru, 80 ciclo plata stojol, haxo junok waso stza' nok' paramuch, oye' ciclo plata stojol.
Ay jun k'u wan sb'eyek' winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' chi', ix awajb'at jun ix ix t'a winh: --Mamin rey, kolin, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato max ach kolji yuj Jehová, ¿tom a hinto wal tik ol ach in kolo'? ¿Tom ol yal wak'an ixim a trigo yet' a wino?
¿Tas tzach ik'ani? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha jun ix ix tik, ix yal ix t'ayin: Ak' jun une' tik ko chi tikne'ik, haxo k'ik'an sko chi'an jun wik tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ko tz'anh wune' chi', ko chi'ani. Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', walan t'a ix to syak' yune' ix chi' ko chi'a, palta toxo ix sk'ub'ejel ix, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh rey tas ix yal jun ix chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Yakb'an wan yek' winh t'a yib'anh muro chi', ix yilan heb' anima ayek' t'a slak'anil chi' to ayoch pichul ya swa yuj winh t'a yol spichul.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': Kotokab'kan yowal sk'ol Dios t'a wib'anh tato max wik'el sjolom winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat t'a jun k'u tik, xchi winh.

Ix schekanb'at jun winh winak winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab'. Ayik manto k'ochlaj jun winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak chi': --Ilek tonab'i, ix schekkot jun winh schekab' jun winh milum anima chi' yik tzul yik'el in jolom winh. Palta maklejek eyab' tas ol wala': Ayik ol jawok winh chi', ol he makel te' puerta tik, wach' tzeyutej he makan te', tzak'an sjawi winh rey t'a spatik winh, xchi winh.

Wanto wal slolon winh ix jawi winh schekab' winh rey chi', ajun pax winh rey chi', ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ha jun yahelal tik, a Jehová ix ak'ankoti. ¿Tasto wal sko te tanhwej tikne'ik yik tzonh skolani? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, ha t'a spuerta'il Samaria tik, a junok almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'e'en, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh stanhwan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay chanhwanh heb' winh ayoch lepra t'ay, ayel heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' chi', ix yal-lan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --¿Tas wal sko k'ulej t'a tik? Tonhej k'ojan onh em ko tanhwan cham ko b'a.

Tato tzonh och t'a yol chonhab' tik, yowalil tzonh cham yuj wejel. Tato tzonh kan k'ojan t'a tik, yowalil ol onh champaxok. Ha tikne'ik koyek t'a scampamento heb' sirio, talaj tzonh yak' niwank'olal heb', max onh smil-laj heb'. Tato ma'ay jun, toxonton yik chamel kaji, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik numnonxo sk'ik'b'i, ix b'at heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh manhxa junok mach ayek'i.

Yujto a Jehová ix ak'an yab' heb' soldado sirio sk'anh yek' carruaje yet' nok' chej yet' pax jun niwan nhilanh soldado. Ha yalan heb' sirio chi' to a winh sreyal heb' israel ix tupan heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik syak'an owal yet' heb' yalani.
Yuj chi' ayik wan sk'ik'b'i ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktankan scampamento heb' yet' smantiado yet' nok' chej yet' scarruaje heb'. Anhej heb' ix skol sb'a.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh ayoch lepra chi' t'ay t'a stitak campamento chi', ix och heb' winh t'a yol junok mantiado, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta k'e'en oro heb' winh, k'e'en plata yet' pichul, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh, ix ochxi heb' winh t'a yol junxo mantiado, ix yik'anelta heb' winh tastak ay t'a yo'ol, ix b'atxi heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli.

Ix laj yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --Manh wach'ok jun wan ko k'ulan tik. Ha tikne'ik smoj wal kik'anb'at ab'ix, palta ichnhejta' kajek'i. Tato sko tanhwej, hato k'ik'an b'at kala', ay ta tas skot t'a kib'anh. Wach' to b'at kalek t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh, ix yawtan heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ix onh xit'ek' t'a scampamento heb' sirio, manhxa junok mach ayek'i, manhxa junok mach skab' sloloni, haxonhej nok' chej yet' nok' b'uru etzjab'kani. Haxo smantiado heb', icha ix aj sb'oankan heb', icha chi' yajkani.
Ix b'at heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' yawtej heb' winh stanhwan spalacio winh rey.

Ix alji yab' winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a opisio yet'ok: --Ol wal t'ayex tas snib'ej heb' sirio chi' tzonh yutej, yujto yojtak heb' to wan ko cham yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan scampamento heb' chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', yuj chi' tato tzonh el t'a spatikel chonhab' tik, ol onh syam heb' t'a pitzanil, haxo yochkankot heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan junok heb' winh schekab' winh icha tik: --B'atokab' jaywanhok winak yila' yet' owanhok nok' chej ayto ek' tik, ol kilani tas ix uji chi'. Tato scham heb', mato ma'ay, lajannhej, yujto ay smay b'aj sb'at heb' chi', ay pax smay t'a tik, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at chab' carruaje heb' yet' nok' chej, ix chekjib'at heb' yuj winh rey chi', yik b'at yil heb' b'ajtil ix b'at heb' sirio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: B'at ilek tas wal yaji, xchi winh.

Ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a yoklem heb' sirio chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a ha' Jordán. Ix yilan heb' to aykan spichul heb' t'a yoltak b'e yet' syamk'ab' heb' ayik wan yel heb' skol sb'a yalani. Elanhchamel ix meltzaj heb' chekab' chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh rey chi' tas ix yil heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta masanil heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' sirio chi' heb', ix yik'ankot heb'. Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a jun almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo plata chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a winh stanhwumal to skan winh stanhwej spuerta'il chonhab' chi', palta ix b'at heb' anima t'a yib'anh winh, ix telwikan winh t'a skal yok heb', ix cham winh, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios t'a winh ayik ix xit'ek' winh rey lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' to ha t'a spuerta'il chonhab' Samaria yab' icha tik k'ik'an, schonhchaj ixim harina, a jun almul ixim, jun ciclo plata stojol. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'e'en, xchi winh.

Haxo jun winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Wach'chom sjakwi swentenail satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo: Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol a walaj ixim, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, yujto a heb' anima ix tek'ancham winh t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a ix aj Sunem, haton ix pitzwinakxi yune' yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Ixik, b'at kajnajan t'a junokxo nación yet' heb' kajan t'a a pat, yujto ix yal Jehová to ol yak'kot junok niwan wejel t'a ko nación tik, uke' ab'il ol yak'a', xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anab'ajej ix sb'ati, icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Ix b'atkan ix t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo. Uke' ab'il ix kan kajan ix ta'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta ix t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'. Ix b'at ix t'a yichanh winh sreyal Israel yik sk'ananxi spat ix yet' slu'um.
Wan slolon winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: Al wab' masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal yik wan yalan winhaj Giezi chi' yab'ixal tas ix aj yak'anxi pitzwok jun yune' jun ix ix chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix jawi ix yal yuj slu'um yet' spat. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Giezi chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, haton wal jun ix ix tik swala', haton jun yune' ix tik pitzwinakxi yuj winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a ix, ix yalan jun ab'ix chi' ix t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan junok heb' schekab' winh rey chi' yik b'at ak'jixi smakb'en ix ix chi' yet' masanil sat awb'en ix el t'a lu'um yiktax ix el ix t'a yol nación chi' masanto ix meltzajxi ix.
Ay junel ix b'at winhaj Eliseo t'a Damasco. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te pena'ay winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria. Ix alchaj t'a winh to ix k'och winh schekab' Jehová ta'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Hazael schekab' icha tik: --Ik'b'at junok silab' tzach b'at il winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Tza k'anan t'a winh to sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová chi' wu'uj, tato olto in b'oxok yuj jun yahelal tik, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Hazael chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix yik'anb'at silab' winh, haton tas te wach' tz'el t'a Damasco chi', 40 nok' camello kuchjinak silab' chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh a chekab' aj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, a winh tzin chekankoti yik tzul in k'anb'an t'ayach, tom olto b'oxok sk'ol winh yuj jun yahelal ayoch t'ay, mato manhxo, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ixik, tzalan t'a winh to ol b'oxok sk'ol winh yuj jun yahelal chi', palta ix yal Jehová to ol chamxonhej winh, xchi winh.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix te och k'elan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a sat winhaj Hazael chi', masanto ix k'ixwi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ok'k'e winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Hazael chi' t'a winh: --Mamin ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Wojtak wal to ol ak' wal chukal t'a heb' wetisraelal, ol ak'och sk'ak'al scuartel heb', ol a milancham heb' kelemtak t'a owal. Ol a milancham heb' kotak unin, ol a tekanelta yol sk'ol heb' ix yab'ix, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Hazael t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik te malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, lajan in icha junok nok' tz'i'. ¿Tas wal ol aj in k'ulan tas icha chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to a ach ol ach ochkan sreyalok Siria tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix spukan sb'a winhaj Hazael chi' yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a winh yajalil chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Hazael chi' icha tik: --Ix yal winh t'ayin tob' ol ach b'oxok yuj jun a yahelal tik, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix sch'ayan jun k'apak k'apak pim winhaj Hazael chi', ix b'at yak'anb'at k'apak winh t'a sat winh rey chi', ix tup yik winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Hazael chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik oyexo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal chi'. Wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Palta ha' sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh, yujto ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Acab chi' winh yetb'eyumok. Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol Jehová ix satel Judá, yujto yak'nakkan sti' t'a winhaj rey David schekab' to ol ochnhejkan yinhtilal winh reyal.
Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix yak'an reyal winh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' aj Edom t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' t'a yol yiko'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' masanil scarruaje yak' owal yet' heb' aj Edom chi' t'a Zair, palta a heb' aj Edom chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik winh yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a scarruaje winh yik owal. Haxo t'ak'walil ix k'e wan winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' edomita chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', a heb' soldado winh chi', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.
Atax ta' ix yikej sb'a heb' aj Edom chi'. Hanheja' pax t'a jun pekti' chi' ix yik'el sb'a chonhab' Libna t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joram chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joram chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haton t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Ocozías winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ocozías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', jun ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Atalía sb'i ix snun winh, yixchikin ix winhaj Omri sreyal Israel.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', a sb'eyb'al winhaj Acab ix sb'eyb'alej winh, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto smam icham winhaj Acab chi' winh.

Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad yet' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, palta ix lajwi winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb' sirio chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'ochkan winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix echnaj yuj heb' sirio chi'. Ix k'och winhaj Ocozías chi' yil winh yujto ya yaj winh.

Ha winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios, ix yawtej jun winh yetchekab'wumal winh kelemto, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ak' lista a b'a, tzach b'at t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Ik'b'at jun yet'tal aceite tik tzach b'ati.

Ayik tzach k'och ta', tza sayanek' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi. Tzach och b'aj ayek' winh chi', tzik'anelta winh t'a skal heb' winh ayek' yet' winh ta', tzik'anb'at winh t'a junokxo cuarto.

Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot aceite chi', tza tob'ank'e t'a sjolom winh, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli yik ol ach och reyal t'a Israel, xchi, xa chi. Slajwi chi' tza jakan puerta, tzach el lemnajok, manh ach och wa'an, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh kelem schekab' Dios t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh ta', molanek' masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach in capitán, ay wal jab' tas ol wal t'ayach, xchi winh. --¿Mach junok onh b'aj tzal chi'? xchi winhaj Jehú. --Ach in capitán, a ach ton tzach wala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e juknaj winhaj Jehú chi', ix och winh t'a yol pat. Ix yak'ank'e aceite winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli, yik ol ach och reyal t'a in chonhab' Israel.

Ha ach ol a satel masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, winh ayach t'a yalanh smandar. Icha chi' ol aj in pakan schamel heb' winh in chekab' yet' heb' winh tz'alanel in lolonel, yujto elnak schik'il heb' winh yuj ix Jezabel.

Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi', yowalil ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' winak, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, ol satel heb' t'a chonhab' Israel. Manhxa junok yinhtilal winh chi' olto kanok.
Icha wutejnak yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, icha wutejnakpax yik winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Haxo pax ix Jezabel jun, a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix t'a yol yik Jezreel, manhxalaj mach ol mukan ix, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan masanil juntzanh tik winh schekab' Dios chi', ix sjakan spuerta'il jun pat chi' winh, ix b'at winh elelal.

Ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Jehú chi' b'aj molanek' heb' winh yetyajalil chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi, wach' hama? ¿Tas yuj ix ul ach yil jun winh kistal chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ha ex tik eyojtakxo winh, eyojtak tas syaltaxon heb' winh schekab' Dios chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

--Ma'ay, manh kojtakoklaj, al t'ayonh tas ix ul yal winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kanel sreyalok Israel tikne'ik, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junjun heb' winh ix yik'el sjukan pichul, ix slich'anem heb' winh t'a yalanh yok winhaj Jehú b'aj b'akhkiltak sk'e'i. Ix laj spu'an sch'a'ak heb' winh, te cha'anh ix yal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Jehú, reyxo winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, te chuk tas sna winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Joram. Ha winhaj Joram chi', aynhejoch winh yet' heb' yetisraelal skolanelta chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria.

Palta ayxo jaye' k'u sk'och winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix lajwi yuj heb' sirio chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hazael chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: Tato t'a wal yel he gana tzin och he reyalok, malaj junok mach tz'el t'a yol chonhab' tik yik wach' malaj mach sb'at halan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh aj Jezreel, xchi winh.
Ix k'e winh t'a yol scarruaje yik owal, ix b'at winh t'a Jezreel b'aj wan yanhtan sb'a winhaj Joram chi'. Aypaxek' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá ta', yujto ayk'och winh yil winhaj Joram chi'.

Ayik ix yilanb'at winh ayk'e t'a cha'anh stanhwej chonhab' Jezreel chi' to wan sjawi winhaj Jehú yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado, ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay juntzanh heb' soldado wan sjawi, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Joram chi' icha tik: --B'atokab' junok winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej, yik b'at yil winh mach jun sjawi chi', sk'anb'anpax t'ay, tom t'a ak'ank'olal sjawi, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at jun winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej chi' yik b'at yil winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankot in k'anb'ej t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wu'uj, xchi winh. Haxo ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Ha winh chekab' chi', ix k'och winh b'aj wan sjawi heb' chi', palta malaj winh smeltzaji, xchi winh.

Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix chekjib'at junxo winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej yuj winh rey chi'. Ix k'och winh soldado chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankoti yik tzul in k'anb'an t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wu'uj, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Hanheja' junxo winh chi' ix k'och winh t'a heb', palta malaj winh smeltzaji. Ha mach sja t'a yol carruaje chi', ichato a winhaj Jehú yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, yujto te lokotak skot winh, ichataxon smodo, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Joram chi': --Hak'ekoch nok' chej t'a in carruaje yik owal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'ochaj scarruaje winhaj Joram sreyal Israel chi' yet' pax yik winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá. Ix b'at heb' winh junjun t'a yol scarruaje chi'. Ix b'at scha'an winhaj Jehú chi' heb' winh. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a lum slu'um winhaj Nabot t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joram chi' to a winhaj Jehú sk'ochi, ix yalan winh: --Ach Jehú, ¿tom t'a ak'ank'olal tzach jawi? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Tom ijan ak'ank'olal tzin jawi yakb'an a ix a nun ix Jezabel, hanheja' yak'anem sb'a ix t'a juntzanh sdiosal yet' t'a yajb'a'alil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joram chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ixto awajkan winh t'a winhaj Ocozías chi': --Ocozías, chamel jun tik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Jehú chi' yet' wal yip winh ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' t'a winhaj Joram chi', awal t'a snanhal yich spatik winh ix ochi, ix k'axpaj t'a spixan winh. Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a yol scarruaje chi', ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winhaj Bidcar, winh skolwaj yet'ok: --Ik'elta winh t'a yol scarruaje chi', tza yumankanb'at winh t'a yol smakb'enkan winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, yujto tzato in nakoti to a ach jun wet'nak ach ayik tzak'an onh och t'a spatik scarruaje winhaj Acab smam jun winh tik, ayik yalannakkan jun lolonel tik Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Acab chi' icha tik:

Ha ewi wil schamel winhaj Nabot yet' heb' yuninal. Hanheja' icha wal chi' ol aj wak'an spak t'ayach t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' ik'elta sniwanil winh chi', tza julankanb'at t'a lum slu'umkan winhaj Nabot chi', yujto icha chi' ajnak yalan Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá tas ix uji chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a sb'e'al Bet-hagán, palta ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a spatik winh, ix yalan winh: --Milekpaxcham jun winh tik, xchi winh. Ix yamchaj winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj heb' t'a switzal Gur t'a slak'anil Ibleam. Hata' ix lajwi winh t'a yol scarruaje chi' yuj heb', palta ixto yal yel winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Meguido. Hata' ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh yuj heb' winh schekab' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol jun carruaje. Ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá ayik yuxluchilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Jezreel. Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel tas ix uji chi', ix yak'an uk' stitak sat ix, ix sjixb'an sjolom ix, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a jun wentena.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Jehú t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Wach'am a k'o'ol? Lajan ach yet' winhaj Zimri, ix a milcham winh ajalil, xchi ix.
Ix k'e k'elan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a jun wentena chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mach ayoch wet'ok? xchi winh. Ay chawanh oxwanh heb' winh munlajwum t'a yol spat ix, ix elta t'anhan heb' winh yila'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ekek emta jun ix ix chi' t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix yekankot sutnaj ix heb' winh, ix laj och tzipnaj schik'il ix t'a sattak yich pat chi' yet' t'a nok' chej, haxo nok' chej chi' ix ek' t'a yib'anh sniwanil ix chi' yet' scarruaje.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' wa'el. Ayik ix lajwi swa winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ilek tas tzeyutej jun ix ix te chuk chi', yujnhej to yisil ix winh rey, yuj chi' mukchajokab' ix, xchi winh.
Ayik ix b'at heb' winh smuk sniwanil ix yalani, ix yilan heb' winh to haxonhej sb'akil sjolom ix, yok ix yet' sk'ab' ix ayek'i.

Haxo ix paxta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jehú tas yaji, ix yalan winh: --Icha tik ix aj yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, winh schekab' to a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix Jezabel t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ha sniwanil ix chi', stza' nok' nok' ol ajkanb'atok, yuj chi' yalxonhej b'aj ol kan t'a sattak lum lum t'a yol yik Jezreel, malaj mach ol alanok: Ina b'aj mukan ix Jezabel tik, manh xchiok heb', xchi Jehová, xchikan winhaj Elías chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria, ay 70 heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Yuj chi' ix stz'ib'ejb'at jun carta winhaj Jehú t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' t'a heb' winh yilumal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a scarta chi' icha tik:
Ha b'aj ayex chi', hata' ayek' heb' yinhtilal winh he reyal, nok' chej, carruaje yik owal, jun chonhab' te wach' yaji yet' jantak syamk'ab' winh yik owal. Yuj chi' ayik ol k'och jun carta tik t'ayex,
tze sik'el junok yinhtilal winh eyajalil chi' te wach', smoj wal yoch he reyalok sk'exulok winh smam chi', tzeyak'an owal yuj yopisio winh eyajalil chi', xchib'at winh t'a heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ina tax maj tzak'wan stek'b'an sb'a chawanh heb' winh rey t'a yichanh winh, okonhxo ¿tom a onh to tik ol yal ko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh winh? xchi heb'.

Haxo winh tz'ilan spalacio winh rey chi' yet' winh sgobernadoral chonhab' chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' pax heb' ix ilan k'ib' heb' yuninal winhaj Acab chi', ix yalb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú chi': Ha onh tik ayonh ek' t'a yol a k'ab'. Masanil tas ol ala' ol ko k'anab'ajej, manh ol kak'ochlaj junokxo ko reyal. Ujokab' icha tas wach' tz'aj a na'ani, xchib'at heb'.

Ix stz'ib'anxib'at junxo carta winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: Tato tze nib'ej tzex och wet'ok, ol he k'anab'ajan tas swala', a k'ik'an tzeyik'kot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh eyajalil chi', tzex jawi t'ayin t'a Jezreel tik, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Ha heb' 70 yinhtilalkan winh rey chi', junnhej yaj heb' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix ilan k'ib' heb' t'a Samaria chi'.

Ayik ix scha'an jun carta chi' heb', ix syaman heb' 70 yinhtilal winh rey chi' heb', ix xikjiel sjolom heb' yuj heb'. Ix yak'anem sjolom heb' chi' heb' t'a yol juntzanh mo'och, ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú t'a Jezreel chi'.

Ix jawi jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Toxo ix ik'chajkot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh rey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Chab' juyanh tzeyutejkan t'a sti' chonhab' tik. Hata' skani masanto k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi', ix och linhan winh t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima: --Ha ex tik, malaj he mul. Ha in ix in milcham winh ko reyal yuj wik'anel winh t'a yopisio, palta ¿mach ix milancham masanil juntzanh heb' tik?

Ha tikne'ik scham wal eyojtakaneli to a masanil tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, malaj junok manh ol elk'ochok. Wan yelk'och masanil tas scheknak Jehová yalkanel winhaj Elías schekab', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', ix smilcham juntzanh sk'ab' yok winhaj Acab chi' winh t'a Jezreel, haton heb' niwak winak yaji yet' heb' yamigo winhaj Acab chi' yet' heb' yak'nakoch winh sacerdote'al. Manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria. Ayik wan sb'at winh chi' t'a yol b'e, ix k'och winh t'a jun b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel.

Hata' ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' sk'ab' yok winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Mach ex a ex tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Ha onh tik ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, onh jawi kak' stzatzil sk'ol heb' winh yuninal winh rey yet' heb' yune' ix reina Jezabel, xchi heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: --Yamec heb', xchi winh. Haxo heb' ajun yet' winh chi' ix yaman heb', ix smilancham heb' winh t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'il ha' skuch Bet-equed b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel chi'. 42 heb' t'a smasanil, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.

Ayik ix helxi winhaj Jehú chi' ta', ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab. Ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mek'an ach am wet'ok, icha in tik wach' in na'an t'a a patik? xchi winh. --I', wach' toni, xchi winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh. --Tato icha chi' an, ak'kot a k'ab' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh, ix yik'ank'e winh winh t'a yol scarruaje chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Konh wet'ok, ol in ch'ox ila' tas ol wutej yik tzin k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Jonadab chi' winh t'a yol scarruaje chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria, ix smilancham masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab winh ta', haton heb' pitzanto ix kani. Yuj chi' pilan ix satel heb' smasanil yuj winh, icha ajnak yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil chonhab' winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winhaj Acab, kennhej ochnak winh ejmelal t'a Baal, a inxo pax tik, ek'b'alto ol in och ejmelal t'a Baal chi'.

Yuj chi' awtejek masanil heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' mach tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'ay yet' masanil heb' sacerdote yaj t'ay. Manhxa junok mach max jawi, yujto ol in b'o jun niwan silab' yuj wik'ancha'anh Baal chi'. Ha mach max jawi, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal jun chi' winh, masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ol satel winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh alchajeli to ol och k'inh yik tz'ik'jicha'anh Baal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel to yowalil sk'och masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal t'a stemplo. Yuj chi' manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ha templo yik Baal chi', te b'ut'an ix aji.
Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' molum pichul to tz'ik'jielta spichul heb' tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Baal, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' yik'anelta.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winh yet' winhaj Jonadab t'a yol templo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi': --Scham heyilani to malajokab' heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová ayek' t'a he kal tik, anhejokab' mach tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ayek'i, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ayik toxo ix och heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi' t'a yol stemplo chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' snhusji yet' juntzanhxo silab'. Yakb'an wan yak'an silab' heb' chi', ayxo och hoyan 80 heb' soldado yuj winhaj Jehú t'a spatik templo chi', ix yalkan winh t'a heb' to malaj junok mach schael heb': --Tato ay junok mach scha'anel junok heb' ayoch ejmelal chi', haxo scham sk'exulok, xchi winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' soldado yet' t'a heb' capitán: --Ochanhek, milekcham heb'. Manhxa junok mach tze chaeli, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix och heb' soldado winh chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' anima chi' heb' t'a k'e'en espada. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta heb' chamnak chi' heb' t'a spatikel templo chi'. Ix och heb' t'a yet'tal Baal t'a yol templo chi'.
Masanil juntzanh yechel ix yik'elta heb', ix snhusantz'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel Baal chi' heb'. Ix sjuanem lanhnaj templo chi' heb' smasanil, yikxo b'aj schulaj anima ix ajnhejkani.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel ejmelal winhaj Jehú t'a Baal t'a kal chonhab' Israel.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Jehú chi', palta maj yik'el-laj sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Maj satel-laj juntzanh yechel wakax winh, haton juntzanh nab'a oro aykan t'a Dan yet' t'a Betel.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Yujto tojol tas ix a k'ulej t'a wichanh, ix a k'anab'ajej a satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' icha wal ix aj walani, a heb' inhtilal, ol ochnhej heb' reyal masanto t'a schanhil makan, xchi t'a winh.

Wach'chom icha chi', palta maj yak'waloch winh t'a sk'ol sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal Israel, yujto maj yik'el sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix och ijan Jehová yik'anek' lum slu'um heb' israel. Ha winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ix ik'anek' lum t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton lum yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, lum yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' lum yik nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ix kotnhej t'a chonhab' Aroer t'a sti' ha' Arnón tzek' t'a Galaad masanto t'a Basán.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jehú yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', 28 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a heb' yetisraelal t'a Samaria. Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria chi', haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Joacaz ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winh yune' ix, haton winhaj rey Ocozías, ix schekan ix satjiel masanil heb' yinhtilal winh rey chi'.

Haxo ix Josaba, yisilkan winhaj rey Joram, schab'il yanab' winhaj rey Ocozías chi', ha' ix ix ik'ankanel winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a skal heb' yuninal winh wan smiljicham chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at sk'ub'ejel winh ix yet' jun ix tz'ilan k'ib' winh t'a jun cuarto b'aj ay juntzanh ch'at sik'an, yuj chi' maj miljokcham winhaj Joás chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ub'chajel winh yet' ix tz'ilank'ib' chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, wake' ab'il ix kan winh ta', yakb'an ayoch ix Atalía yajalil t'a Judá chi'.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, a winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada yetb'eyum ix Josaba chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo yet' heb' stanhwan spalacio winh rey. Ha winh ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Hata' ix schek winh yak' sti' heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' winh t'a tas nab'il yuj. Ixlajwi chi' ix ch'oxjioch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a heb'.
Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a heb': Haton tik ol he k'ulok: Ay ex mach ex ol ex ochkan he tanhwej spalacio winh rey t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip,
ayex pax mach ex ol he tanhwej spuerta'il yik Shur, hanhejtona' ayex mach ex ol he tanhwej spuerta'il spat heb' stanhwan winh rey. Icha chi' ol aj he kannhej he tanhwej yik malaj mach sk'och ta'.
Ha exxo tzex elkan t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi' jun, cha makan tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan stemplo Jehová t'a stz'eytak winh rey.

Tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak b'aj ay winh chi', junjun heb' yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal. Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a he kal b'aj tzolan ex och chi', tojolnhej schami. Yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh rey chi', tzex b'at yet' winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' capitán chi' tastak ix yal winhaj Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' ix yak'och soldado heb', heb' tz'och stanhwej t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'e'en lanza winh yet' k'e'en smaklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' capitán chi', haton k'e'en aykan yuj winhaj rey David t'a yol stemplo Jehová chi'.
Ix och hoyan heb' soldado chi' stanhwan t'a yamak'il templo yet' t'a spatiktak altar yet' t'a spatik yichanh winh rey chi'. Junjun heb', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Ix yik'anelta winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Joiada chi', ix yak'ank'e corona winh t'a sjolom winh, ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios winh t'a winh. Ix stob'ank'e aceite winh t'a sjolom winh unin chi', ix yalan winh to reyxo winh. Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix stz'it sk'ab', ix syamanoch heb' yawaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía yel yaw heb' winh soldado yet' heb' anima chi' yek'i, ix jawi ix t'a stemplo Jehová b'aj ayek' heb' anima smasanil.

Haxo ix yilan ix ayek' winh rey chi', linhanoch winh t'a stz'ey jun oy t'a amak' chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb'. Ha t'a stz'eytak winh rey chi' ayek' heb' yajal yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch sonal heb' sb'itani. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb', spu'an sch'a'ak heb'. Yuj chi' ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul ix, ix el yaw ix: --Pechum ex el yajal a ex tik. Pechum ex el yajal, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj sacerdote Joiada t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ik'ekel ix a ex tzolan ex ek' chi'. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an yuj ix miljokab'chamok, xchi winh. Yujto toxo ix yal winh sacerdote chi' to max yal-laj smiljicham ix t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jielta ix t'a skal heb' chi', ix ik'chajb'at ix b'aj tz'ochk'och sb'e heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej sk'och t'a spalacio winh rey. Hata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' to sb'okan junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová. Ix yalanpax winh to ayokab' junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smak'anem lanhnaj stemplo Baal heb', ix smak'anpoj juntzanh altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel. Ix mak'jipaxcham winhaj Matán, sacerdote yaj t'a Baal chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh altar chi'. Ix yak'anoch stanhwumal stemplo Jehová winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix elta heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo, haton heb' stanhwan winh rey chi' yet' masanil anima. Yaman ix aj yel heb' yet' winh rey t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a palacio. Ha t'a spuerta'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palacio chi' ix k'och heb', ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a yol sk'ojnub' heb' rey.
Masanil heb' anima, ix tzalajk'e heb', yujto a ix Atalía toxo ix miljicham ix t'a sti' palacio chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan jun chonhab' chi' t'a junk'olal.
Uke' ab'il sk'inal winhaj rey Joás chi' ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá.
Ayik ukexo ab'il yoch winhaj Jehú reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Joás chi' reyal t'a Judá. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix k'ayb'aj winh yuj winhaj sacerdote Joiada.
Palta a b'aj syak'em sb'a anima t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ixto yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan incienso heb' ta'.

Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote: --Molek k'e'en tumin yet' k'e'en ofrenda tz'ik'jikot t'a stemplo Jehová, k'e'en yowalil syak' junjun anima yet' jantak k'e'en ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani. Junjun ex ol eyak' k'e'en tumin ol he cha chi' yuj sb'oji templo, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Palta ayik ix el 23 ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', manta jab'ok stemplo Jehová chi' sb'o heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Joiada yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj manta jab'ok templo tik tze b'o'o? Ha tikne'ik t'a kichanhb'at tik, manhxo'ok ex laj ol he cha k'e'en tumin t'a heb' anima tik. Ha jantak k'e'en tumin ol ak'jok, yowalil skan k'e'en yik sb'oji templo chi', xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'ol heb' winh sacerdote chi' to manhxo'oklaj heb' winh scha'an k'e'en tumin chi', manhxa paxlaj yalan yik heb' winh sb'o'an stemplo Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun kaxa winhaj Joiada chi', ix yolan smakul te' winh, ix yak'ankan te' winh t'a slak'anil altar t'a stojolal swach' mach tz'och t'a yol templo chi'. Haton ta' syak'em k'e'en tumin heb' winh sacerdote stanhwan sti' templo scha t'a heb' anima sk'och t'a templo chi'.

Ayik syilan heb' winh to niwanxo k'e'en tumin chi' ay t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sk'och jun winh stz'ib'um winh rey yet' winh sat sacerdote chi', sb'isan k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh. Slajwi chi' syak'anem k'e'en heb' winh t'a yol juntzanh mukuk.

Ayik slajwi sb'isan k'e'en chi' heb' winh, syak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilumalok munlajel tas tz'aj sb'oxi templo chi', yik stupchaj heb' winh snhikan te te', heb' winh tz'ilan sb'o munlajel chi',

heb' winh albañil yet' heb' winh b'o'um k'e'en. Ix manchaj pax te te' yet' k'e'en k'e'en mak'b'ilpojok yik tz'och t'a munlajel chi'. Sk'anchajpax k'e'en tumin chi' t'a juntzanhxo tas smanchaj yuj munlajel chi'.

Ha k'e'en tumin syik'b'at heb' t'a templo chi', max k'anchajlaj k'e'en yik sb'ochaj juntzanh waso, pultu, k'e'en ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil, k'e'en niwak uk'ab' yet' trompeta yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro yet' plata.
Palta a masanil k'e'en tumin chi', ha t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan munlajel yik sb'oji stemplo Jehová chi', ha t'a heb' winh tz'ak'ji k'e'en.
Maj ch'olb'itaj smunlajel heb' winh scha'an k'e'en tumin chi', yik slaj stupan heb' winh munlajwum heb' winh, yujto te tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'o'ani.
Haxo pax k'e'en tumin tz'ak'ji yuj spakok mul yet' silab' tz'ak'chaj yuj stupchaj mul, max ak'jilaj k'e'en t'a templo chi', yujto yik heb' winh sacerdote yaj k'e'en.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, ix jawi winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Gat, ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix lajwi chi' ix kot winh t'a sb'e'al Jerusalén yak' owal.

Ha winhaj Joás sreyal Judá, ix smolb'ej jantak tas yak'nak heb' smam yicham winh t'a stemplo Jehová, haton winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram yet' winhaj Ocozías. Ix smolb'anpax juntzanh tas yak'nak winh t'a templo chi' yet' masanil k'e'en oro ayxo ek' ta' yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalacio winh. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winhaj Hazael chi', yuj chi' majxo yak'laj owal chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winhaj Joás chi', ix smol halan heb' winh t'a spatik winh. Ix smilancham winh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan t'a ti' b'e tz'emta t'a Sila.

Ha heb' winh ix milancham winh chi', haton winhaj Josacar yuninal winhaj Simat yet' winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Somer. Ayik ix cham winh chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David. Haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amasías ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 23 ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Jehú yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj wal chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a heb' israel chi', niwan tiempo ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Ben-adad.
Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Joacaz chi' t'a Jehová, ix ab'chaj slesal winh chi', yujto ix yil Jehová tas wal tz'utaj heb' israel yuj winh sreyal Siria chi',
yuj chi' ix ak'ji jun mach skolwaj t'a heb' yuj Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sirio chi', ix kanxi heb' t'a junk'olal, ichataxon yajek' heb' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Palta maj yaktejkanlaj heb' sb'eyb'alan juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Ix k'enhejcha'anh heb' yet' jun chukal chi', hanheja' ayek' jun yechel Asera t'a Samaria chi'.

Ha heb' soldado winhaj Joacaz chi', kenxonhej sb'isul heb', yujto a winh sreyal Siria ix satanel heb'. 50-xonhej heb' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, lajunhe' carruaje yik owal yet' 10 mil soldado sb'ey t'a yok ayek'i.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Joacaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Joás winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 37 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix schael yich winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Joás sreyal Israel chi', ix xit'ek' winh yil winhaj Eliseo ayik te pena'ay winhaj Eliseo chi' yuj jun yab'il ix ik'an schami. Yuj chi' ix ok'k'e winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh, ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ik'kot junok a jul-lab' yet' jaye'ok sjul-lab'il, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Jak wentena t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix sjakan winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': B'o'och a jul-lab' chi' yik ol ach julwajok, xchi winh. Yakb'an yamb'il te' yuj winh rey chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' winhaj Eliseo t'a yib'anh sk'ab' winh rey chi'. --Julwajanh an, xchi winh. Ix julwajb'at winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha a jul-lab' tik sch'oxanel skolwal Jehová t'a schonhab' to ol ak' ganar heb' sirio t'a Afec, ol a satanel heb' smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Yam juntzanh a jul-lab', xchi winh. Ayik ix syaman sjul-lab' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha tikne'ik, tekub'tanhejem t'a sat lu'um, xchi winh. Yuj chi' oxel ix stekem winh rey chi', ix och wa'an winh.
