Ix kot yowal winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Oktom ix a tekem oel wakelok, tato icha chi', icham chi' ol aj a satanel heb' sirio chi' smasanil. Okxo jun, oxelnhej ol ak' ganar heb', xchi winh.
Ix cham winhaj Eliseo chi', ix mukchaj winh. Junjun ab'il tzulnhejek' heb' moabita elk'al t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel.

Ha junel, ix b'at juntzanh heb' israel smuk jun chamnak. Ayik wan sk'och heb' b'aj ol smuk chi', ix yilan heb' sjawi heb' elk'um chi', toxonhej ix syumkanoch jun chamnak chi' heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at heb' elelal. Ayik ix och tennaj jun chamnak chi' t'a sb'akil winhaj Eliseo chi', ix pitzwixi, ix k'ex linhan.
Ix te ixtaj wal heb' israel yuj winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ayik pitzanto winhaj rey Joacaz.

Palta ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heb', ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yujnhej strato yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj chi' maj schalaj satjiel heb', maj yik'el-laj heb' t'a yichanh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria chi', haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Ben-adad ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz ix ik'anxikanek' juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winhaj Hazael t'a winhaj rey Joacaz ayik ix yak'an owal heb'. Oxel ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Ben-adad yuj winhaj Joás chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh skolanxikan juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Amasías chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Joadán sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'ochlaj icha sk'ulejnak winhaj David, haton smam yicham winh. Ha sb'eyb'al winhaj Joás winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej.
Ha juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima ta', ix snhusanpax incienso heb'.
Ayik ix yik'an wal yip yopisio winhaj Amasías chi', ix smilcham heb' winh ay yopisio winh, haton heb' winh miljinak cham winh smam winh.

Palta maj smilchamlaj heb' yuninal heb' winh ix cham chi' winh, yujto tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés, b'aj syalkan Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il, max yal-laj scham heb' yuj smul yuninal, hanhejtona' heb' uninab'il, max yalpax scham heb' yuj smul smam, palta junjun mach scham yuj smul, xchi Jehová.
Ix smilpaxcham 10 mil heb' edomita winhaj Amasías t'a owal t'a lum Spanhanil Atz'am Atz'am. Ix yak'pax ganar chonhab' Sela winh, ix yak'ankan skuch winh Jocteel, haton chi' ix sb'iejkani.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winh t'a winhaj Joás sreyal Israel, yuninal winhaj Joacaz yixchikin winhaj Jehú. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Kotanh, kak' owal, xchib'at winh.

Palta ix yak'anb'at spak winhaj Joás chi' icha tik: Ay jun te' sak k'i'ix, ix yalb'at te' t'a te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano: Ak' ix isil yetb'eyumok winh wunin, xchi te'. Palta haxo nok' chium nok' ix ek' ta', ix stek'anem lat'an te' sak k'i'ix chi' nok'.

Yel ix ak' ganar heb' edomita chi', yuj chi' tzik'walcha'anh a b'a tikne'ik. Wach' toni, ik'cha'anh a b'a t'a a pat. Tato tza nib'ej ak' owal wet'ok, a jun chi' tonhej ol kot t'a ib'anh yuj yet' t'a yib'anh Judá, xchib'at winh.
Palta maj schalaj yab' juntzanh chi' winhaj Amasías chi'. Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Joás chi' yak' owal yet' winh, ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a Bet-semes t'a yol yik Judá.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Judá chi' yuj heb' soldado yik Israel, toxonhej ix el lemnaj heb', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ix yamchaj winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá chi' yuj winhaj Joás chi' t'a Bet-semes chi', ix ik'jik'e winh t'a Jerusalén yuj winh. Ix sjuanem 180 metro smuro'al chonhab' chi' heb' soldado, ix b'at t'a puerta yik heb' aj Efraín masanto t'a spuerta'il schikin.

Ix yik'anpax masanil k'e'en oro winhaj Joás chi', k'e'en plata yet' pax masanil tastak ay t'a stemplo Jehová yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalacio winhaj rey Amasías chi'. Ay pax juntzanh anima ix yik'b'at winh t'a Samaria yik tz'ak'ji pural winhaj Amasías chi' yoch junk'olal yet' winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás sreyal Judá chi', 15 ab'ilto ix kan winh ayik ix cham winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amasías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh ay t'a Jerusalén ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Amasías chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh elelal t'a Laquis. Palta ix ochnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' hata' ix cham winh yuj heb' winh.
Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a yib'anh chej, ix mukji winh t'a Jerusalén b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj David.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá ix ak'anoch winhaj Azarías reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. 16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'.
Ayik ayxo och winh reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi', ix yik'anxiek' chonhab' Elat winh, ix sb'oanxik'e winh.
Ayik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' ix ik'anxiek' b'aj tzek'taxon smojonal smakb'en Israel, sb'atnhej b'aj tz'ochk'och b'e t'a Hamat masanto t'a ha' mar yik Arabá, icha aj yalannakkan Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Jonás schekab', haton winh yuninal winhaj Amitai aj Gat-hefer.
Yujto ix yil Jehová to te ya tzek' heb' israel smasanil, malaj wal junok mach skolwaj yet' heb'.
Yuj chi' a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ix yak'lab'ej Jehová skolan heb', yujto malaj t'a spensar Jehová satanel schonhab' t'a junelnhej.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jeroboam chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak owal ix yak' winh ayik ix yik'anxiek' juntzanh chonhab' winh t'a Judá, haton Damasco yet' Hamat, masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' winh sreyal Israel, haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 27 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, hata' ix schael yich winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Amasías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Azarías chi' wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.
Palta a juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima, ix snhusanpax incienso heb' ta'.

Ix yak'och jun yab'il skuch lepra Jehová t'a winh rey chi' masanto ix cham winh. Yuj chi', majxo ajlaj winh rey chi' t'a spalacio, ch'ok patil b'aj ix ajek' winh. Haxo winhaj Jotam, winh yuninal winh, ha' winh ix och yilumalok spalacio winh chi', ix yak'anpax yajalil winh t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Azarías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj rey David t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haxo winhaj Jotam winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 38 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, wake' ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Haxo winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Jabes ix och ajk'olal t'a winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winhaj Zacarías chi', ix smilancham winh winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zacarías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, ayik yalannak to a heb' yinhtilal winh, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal chi'.
Ha winhaj Salum chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, palta junnhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Haxo winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi ix kot yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Tirsa, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tifsa. Ix smilancham masanil heb' anima heb' winh ta' yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en Tifsa chi'. Ix tekjielta yol sk'ol heb' ix yab'ix yuj heb' winh. Masanil tas ay ta', ix yik'b'at heb' winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh yujto maj chajioch heb' winh yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Manahem chi' t'a Samaria yak' owal yet' winhaj Salum chi'. Ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Salum chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Salum chi' yet' tas ix aj yoch winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Zacarías, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 10 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak b'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha t'a stiempo'al ayoch winhaj Manahem reyal chi',
ix jawi winhaj Pul sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a Israel chi'. Yuj chi' 750 quintal k'e'en plata ix yak' winh t'a winhaj Pul chi' yik tz'och winh yet' winh yik wach' skannhej winh t'a yopisio.

Ix yak'och 50 siclo k'e'en plata winhaj Manahem chi' t'a yib'anh junjun heb' b'eyum t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi', yik syal stupan k'e'en tumin syak' winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smeltzaj winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a schonhab', majxo ochlaj wa'an winh t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manahem yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi' ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Pekaía winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 50 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Pekaía yuninal winhaj Manahem reyal t'a Israel. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Palta a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yajal heb' winh soldado winhaj Pekaía chi', ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Pekaía chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a 50 heb' winak aj Galaad yet' winh. Ix miljicham winhaj Pekaía chi' yuj heb' winh t'a scuartel t'a yol spalacio t'a Samaria yet' winhaj Argob yet' winhaj Arie. Haxo winhaj Peka chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Pekaía chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 52 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel. 20 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha t'a stiempo'al ayoch winhaj Peka reyal t'a Israel chi', hata' ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' tik yuj winh: Haton Ijón, Abel-bet-maaca, Janoa, Cedes, Hazor, Galaad, Galilea yet' masanil yol yik Neftalí. Masanil heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' icha preso t'a Asiria chi'.

Ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', ix smilancham winhaj Peka chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Peka yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Azarías smam winh.
Ix sb'o'okh spuerta'il stemplo Jehová winh t'a yib'anh, palta a juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan incienso heb' ta'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jotam yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix och ijan Jehová yak'ankot winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yak' owal yet' Judá chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jotam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David, winh smam yicham winh. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Acaz yuninal winhaj Jotam yak'an reyal t'a Judá.

Ayxo 20 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Anhej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix snhustz'a yuninal winh silab'il. Lajan wal ix sk'ulej winh icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación ik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ayik yochnak heb' israel t'a lu'um tik.
Hanhejtona' ix yak' silab' winh, ix snhusanpax incienso winh t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel, ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jerusalén yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winhaj rey Acaz chi'. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', palta maj yak'laj ganar heb' winh.

Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi', a winh sreyal Edom ix ak'an ganar chonhab' Elat, ix ochkan yikok Edom chi'. Ha heb' aj Judá kajan ta', ix pechjiel heb' yuj winh, haxo heb' aj Edom chi' ix kannhej kajan ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' schekab' winhaj Acaz t'a winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, yik sb'at alchaj t'a winh icha tik: Swak'och in b'a t'a yol a k'ab'. Yuj chi' kotanh yuj tzul in a kolan t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria yet' winh sreyal Israel, yujto wan yak'an owal heb' winh wet'ok, xchi b'at winh.
Yuj chi', a winhaj Acaz chi', ix yik'elta k'e'en plata winh yet' k'e'en oro t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'e'en ay t'a spalacio winh, ix sianb'at k'e'en winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winh sreyal Asiria chi' tas ix yal winhaj Acaz chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a Damasco. Ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh. Ha heb' kajan ta', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh t'a Quir. Ix smilanpaxcham winhaj Rezín chi' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco scha winhaj Tiglat-pileser chi'. Hata' ix yil jun altar winh, ix stz'ib'anb'at yechel jun altar chi' winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Urías t'a Jerusalén.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'oank'e jun altar winhaj sacerdote Urías chi', lajan ix aj icha yechel ix yak'kot winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco chi'. Wach'xo yaji ayik ix jax winhaj Acaz chi' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yilan jun altar chi' winh, ix snitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey yik snhusantz'a silab' winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'an nok' silab' winh stz'a smasanil yet' ofrenda yet' tas swaji. Ix sekanpaxem wino winh t'a yib'anh altar chi' t'a ofrenda'il. Ix stzikanpaxoch schik'il nok' silab' yik junk'olal winh t'a spatiktak altar chi'.
Haxo pax altar bronce ay t'a yichanh stemplo Jehová, ix yik'el winh t'a skal jun ak' altar chi' yet' stemplo Jehová chi', ix yak'an kan winh t'a stojolal snorte'al jun ak' altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Urías chi' icha tik: Ha tikne'ik a masanil nok' silab' tz'ak'ji t'a k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji yet' wino, anhej t'a yib'anh jun ak' altar tik tz'ak'ji. Hanheja' juntzanhxo silab' syak' heb' chonhab' yet' wik a in tik, ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' stz'ai. Stzikchajpaxoch schik'il nok' silab' chi' t'a spatiktak. Palta haxo jun altar bronce chi', wik tz'ajkani yik hata' tzin k'anb'ej in b'a t'a Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Urías chi' icha wal ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'chajel yol sat smarcoal juntzanh carreta nab'a bronce t'a templo. Ix ik'chajpaxel palangana ayem t'a yib'anh. Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en yechel mam wakax nab'a bronce ayoch t'a yalanh jun niwan pila, haxo t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en t'a sat lu'um ix yak'kanem winh.

Yik wach' skan winh t'a sat winh sreyal Asiria chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el jun yet'tal b'aj skan heb' rey t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip winh t'a stemplo Jehová yet' spuerta'il ay t'a spatikeli, haton b'aj tz'och winh rey t'a templo chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab'kan winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 12 ab'il yoch winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och reyal t'a Israel, b'alunhe' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, wach'chom maj k'och ijan icha schukal juntzanh heb' winh rey ek'nak t'a Israel chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria, ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Oseas chi'. Ix kan winhaj Oseas chi' t'a yalanh smandar winh, ix yak'an k'e'en tumin winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a junjun ab'il.

Palta ix yaktej winhaj Oseas chi' yak'an k'e'en tumin chi', ix schekanb'at schekab' winh t'a winhaj So sreyal Egipto yik skolwaj winh yet' winh yik tz'el winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' a winhaj rey Salmanasar ix yaman winhaj Oseas chi', ix yak'anoch winh winh t'a preso.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix syamanoch winh yik'anek' masanil smakb'en Israel chi'. Oxe' ab'il ix yoymitej chonhab' Samaria winh.

Haxo ix aji, ha t'a sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas chi' reyal, ix ak'ji ganar Samaria yuj winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at masanil heb' israel t'a preso. Haxo t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yik heb' medo, ix ak'jib'at heb' yuj winh.

Icha chi' ix aj skot jun chi' t'a yib'anh heb' israel chi', yujto ix och wal smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Ha Jehová chi' ik'jinakelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ochnak heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
sb'eyb'alannak sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación heb', haton juntzanh yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al b'aj ix kuchb'aj heb' yuj juntzanh heb' winh sreyal.

Elk'altak ix sk'ulej juntzanh tas manh wach'ok heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal, ix sb'oank'e juntzanh lugar cha'anh heb' t'a junjun niwak chonhab' yet' t'a junjun cuartel, yik b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en heb' yik syal sb'a heb' t'ay, ix sb'oanpax te te' heb' yik yechel jun sdiosal heb' skuch Asera. Ha t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yich te te' k'ayum xi'il sb'o juntzanh chi' heb'.
Hata' ix snhus incienso heb' icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh heb'. Ix stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' heb'.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, haton wal juntzanh yalnak Jehová to ay yowalil yoch heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Ix schek Jehová yal heb' schekab' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá: Naek he b'a t'a masanil he chuk b'eyb'al, k'anab'ajejek masanil cheknab'il, kachnab'il yet' masanil k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Hanheja' heb' in chekab' wan yalan heb' t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xchi heb'.
Palta manh wal jab'ok ix scha heb' yab'i, te pit ix yutej spensar heb' icha yutejnak sb'a heb' smam yicham heb', yujto maj yak'och Jehová sDiosal heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Ix spatikejel ley heb' yet' trato sb'onak Jehová yet' heb' smam yicham heb' chi'. Ix spatikejpaxel cheknab'il ix alchaj t'a heb'. Ix ochpax tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Ha yuj juntzanh chi' manhxa jab'ok yelk'och heb', haxonhej schuk b'eyb'al juntzanhxo nación ix sb'eyb'alej heb', juntzanh to ay yowalil yuj Jehová sb'eyb'alaji.

Ix yaktankan masanil scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb', ix sb'o'an chab' yechel wakax heb' sdiosalok. Ay pax jun te' yechel ix Asera b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'anal yet' t'a Baal.

Ix snhusantz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios, ix sk'anb'an sb'a heb' t'a heb' naumel lolonel yet' t'a heb' aj chum. Ix ste k'ulejnhej chukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Icha wal chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb'.
Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Israel, ix yik'anel heb' t'a yichanh. Haxonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yuj.
Maj sk'anab'ajej pax scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb' aj Judá chi'. Palta ix sb'eyb'alej heb' icha wal tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ix patikanel Jehová, ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'ixtaj heb' yuj heb', masanto ix yal yel heb' t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ayik ix ik'jiel lajunhe' inhtilal heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj David, haxo winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ix yak'och heb' sreyalok. Haton winh ix kuchb'anel heb' t'a spatik Jehová, te niwan chukal ix sk'ulej heb' yuj winh.
Icha wal chi' ix te aj yoch smul heb', ix sk'ulejnhej heb' icha chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Jeroboam chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yik'el heb' israel chi' Jehová t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalankan heb' schekab'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' preso t'a Asiria, ix kannhej heb' ta'.

Ha winh sreyal Asiria chi' ix ik'ankot heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Babilonia, Cuta, Ava, Hamat yet' Sefarvaim. Haton heb' chi' ix kajnaj yuj winh t'a yol yik Samaria sk'exulok heb' israel. Icha chi' ix ajek' kajan juntzanh anima chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Samaria chi'.
Ha juntzanh anima ix jawi kajan chi', max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ix yak'kot nok' choj Jehová t'a skal heb', ix miljicham jaywanh heb' yuj nok'.

Ix alchaj t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Ha heb' anima ix ak'b'at t'a Samaria yik b'at kajnaj heb' ta', manh yojtakok heb' yoch ejmelal t'a sDiosal jun lugar chi', yuj chi' a jun Dios chi' schekankot nok' choj t'a heb', smiljicham heb' yuj nok', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji meltzaj junok heb' winh sacerdote ik'b'ilb'at t'a preso chi' yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi', yik wach' tz'aj winh ta', yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj winh t'a tas snib'ej sDiosal jun chonhab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot junok heb' winh sacerdote aj Samaria ik'b'ilb'at chi'. Haxo t'a Betel ix aj winh, ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' winh t'a tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová.
Palta junjun chonhab'il heb' ix sb'o sdiosal t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj kajan. Ix sb'oanxik'e lugar heb' cha'anh b'aj b'ob'iltaxon yuj heb' aj Samaria chi'.
Ha heb' aj Babilonia, ix sb'o yechel Sucot-benot heb'. Haxo heb' aj Cuta, ix sb'o yechel Nergal heb'. Haxo heb' aj Hamat, ix sb'o yechel Asima heb'.

Haxo heb' aj Ava, ix sb'o yechel Nibhaz heb' yet' yechel Tartac. Haxo pax heb' aj Sefarvaim, ix snhustz'a yalyuninal heb' silab'il t'a yechel Adramelec yet' t'a Anamelec, haton juntzanh chi' sdiosal heb'.
Skomon ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Syak'anpaxoch heb' yetchonhab' heb' sacerdote'al yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.
Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, palta hanheja' yoch heb' ejmelal t'a skomon Dios, icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima b'aj kotnak heb'.

Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' icha sb'eyb'altaxon t'a peka'. Max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, max sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, haton winh ix ak'ji skuch Israel.
Ayik ix sb'o'an strato Jehová yet' heb' israel, ix yalani: Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh eyak' serwil, manh eyak' he silab' t'ay.
Palta anhej t'ayin tzex och ejmelal, yujto Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yet' in poder, yuj chi' anhej wal t'ayin yowalil tzex och ejmelal, anhej t'ayin tzeyak'pax he silab'.
Hanhejtona' tze k'anab'ajej masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, in cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tz'ib'yajkani. Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha in trato tzin b'o tik heyet'ok, manh eyak'b'at satk'olal. Manh ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
palta anhej t'ayin Jehová he Diosal in tik tzex och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Palta a juntzanh anima chi', maj schalaj yab' heb'. Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' ichataxon sb'eyb'al. Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb', ix sb'eyb'alejnhej sb'eyb'al heb' smam yicham heb'.
Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a israel, ix och winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá.
25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abi sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Ezequías chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Maj schaochlaj heb' anima winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh. Ix schekan winh mak'jokpoj juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en chajul yaj t'a heb'. Ix ch'akchajel juntzanh te te' yechel Asera. Ix mak'jipoj jun k'e'en yechel chan bronce b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés, yujto snhus incienso heb' israel chi' t'ay, Nehustán ix sb'iejkan k'e'en yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', a Jehová sDiosal Israel ix yak'och winh yipok sk'o'ol. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh sreyal Judá, heb' ek'nakxo yet' heb' tzak'anto ochnak yuj winhaj Ezequías chi', malaj junok lajan spensar yet' winh.
Te k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová. Malaj junelok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'ay. Masanil scheknab'il Jehová yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés, ix sk'anab'ajej winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej ix aj yelk'ochi, yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh. Ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria, majxo yak'laj k'e'en tumin winh t'a winh.
Ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo winh, heb' ay t'a juntzanh cuartel yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' ayoch smuro'al, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Gaza yet' b'aj sk'och smakb'en Gaza chi'.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a Israel, ix yoymitan chonhab' Samaria winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado.
Ayik ix lajwi yoxil ab'il yoymitan heb', ix yak'an ganar Samaria chi' heb'. Ix uji jun chi' ayik wakexo ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías chi' reyal, b'alunhexo pax ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas reyal t'a Israel.
Ix yik'b'at heb' israel winhaj Salmanasar chi' t'a Asiria. Ha t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik heb' medo ix aj heb' yuj winh.
Icha chi' ix uji yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix yutej sb'a heb' israel t'a Jehová sDiosal, ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a strato, maj schalaj yab' heb' tas alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová.

Ayik 14 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a masanil chonhab' ay smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá chi', ix laj ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at jun u'um winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh sreyal Asiria t'a Laquis, ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Ix och in mul t'ayach, ik'el a soldado ayoch t'a sat ko lugar tik, ol wak' k'e'en tumin ayoch t'a wib'anh u'uj, xchib'at winh. Yuj chi', 225 quintal k'e'en plata yet' 23 quintal k'e'en oro ix yak'och winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi'.
Masanil k'e'en plata ayek' t'a yol stemplo Jehová ix yak'b'at winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' jantakxo sb'eyumal winh ay t'a yol spalacio.

Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en oro winh, haton k'e'en ayoch t'a templo chi', k'e'en ayoch t'a spuerta'il yet' t'a smarcoal, haton k'e'en yak'nakoch winh t'a spuerta'il templo chi'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot oxwanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix el heb' t'a Laquis, ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ix sb'o'an scampamento heb' b'aj tz'emul yoktak jun stanqueal ha ha' ay t'a yib'anh, t'a yol b'e sb'at b'aj sjuk'wi heb' jalum k'apak.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj winhaj rey Ezequías yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi' a heb' winh oxwanh tik ix schekb'at winh rey chi', yik sb'at lolon heb' winh yet' heb': Haton winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Hilcías, winh stanhwumal spalacio winh rey chi', winhaj Sebna tz'ib'um ab'ix yet' winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Asaf, stz'ib'um winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan jun winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria chi' t'a heb' winh: --Alek t'a winhaj Ezequías tas syal winh sreyal Asiria, winh niwan yelk'och t'a sat lu'um tik: ¿Tas ayoch yipok a k'o'ol?
¿Tom tza na' to yujnhej sjelanil a pensar syal ak'an ganar heb' in soldado jelan t'a owal? ¿Tas ayoch yipok a k'o'ol yuj chi' tzach och ajk'olal t'ayin?

Ix wila'' to a Egipto tzak'och yipok a k'o'ol. Wach' toni, yujto a Egipto chi' lajan wal icha junok te' aj pojeltakxo. Ayik sko k'okochan te', tzek' paknaj te', haxo sjayil snhi' te' sb'at t'a ko k'ab'. Icha chi' yaj winh sreyal Egipto t'a mach tz'ak'anoch winh yipok sk'o'ol.

Ach Ezequías, tekan tzal icha tik: Ha onh tik a Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. Palta ina toxo ix a chek satjiel juntzanh altar b'aj cha'anh, b'aj tz'och heb' anima ejmelal t'a jun he Diosal chi'. Ix halani to junxonhej altar b'aj tz'och heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ejmelal.

Ha tikne'ik b'o junok a trato yet' winh wajalil, haton winh sreyal Asiria. Syal winh t'ayach icha tik: Ol wak' chab'ok mil nok' chej t'ayach, tato tz'ilchaj heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' u'uj. ¿Tom ol yal u'uj?
Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol tzak'wan eyak'an owal yet' jun nhilanh heb' ko soldado aj Asiria wanto sk'ayi, wach'chom tze komon ak'ejoch heb' aj Egipto yet' scarruaje yipok he k'o'ol?
Hanhejtona', ¿tom tza na' to tzonh komon jawi ko satel jun chonhab' tik tato manhok Jehová ayoch ket'ok? Haton wal ix onh chekankot ul ex ko sateli.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliaquim, winhaj Sebna yet' winhaj Joa t'a jun winh yajal soldado chi': --Tzonh tewi t'ayach to ha t'a arameo tzal t'ayonh, yujto skab' arameo chi'. Palta manh ach lolon t'a hebreo chi', yujto syab' masanil anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab', xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh yajal heb' soldado chi': --Manhoknhej t'ayex yet' t'a winh he reyal b'aj ix in chekjikot yuj winh in reyal yik tzul walan juntzanh lolonel tik. Palta haton wal t'a masanil heb' anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh muro chi' b'aj swala', yujto ol yab' sya'il heb' heyet'ok, ol he lo he tza', ol eyuk'an he chul tato tz'och owal.
Yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winh yajalil heb' soldado chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh t'a hebreo: --Ab'ek wal tas syal winh rey te niwan yelk'ochi, haton winh sreyal Asiria:
Manh eyak' he b'a yixtej winhaj Ezequías chi'. ¿Tokwal ol yal ex skolanel winh t'a yol in k'ab'?

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi' snib'ej winh to a Jehová tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol. Syalan winh icha tik: Wal yel ol onh skol Jehová ko Diosal. Manh ol ak'jokoch ko chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' yuj, xchi winh.

Palta manh he cha eyab' tas syal winh chi', xchi winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yujto a winh rey chi' tzul chekan wal t'ayex tato tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh t'a ak'ank'olal, ol he lo sat eyawb'en te', icha te' uwa yet' te' higo. Ol eyuk'anpax ha ha' joyb'il eyu'uj.

Ol lajwok chi', ol ex yik'anb'at winh t'a jun lum lum lajan icha heyik tik, b'aj ay te' uwa yet' ixim trigo. Ol he b'o he pan yet' he wino. Ay pax aceite yet' te' olivo yet' nok' yalchab'. Wach' ol aj yek' eyu'uj, manh ol ex chamlaj yuj wejel. Palta manh eyak'och t'a he k'ol tas syal winhaj Ezequías chi', yujto tonhej tzex yixtej winh syalan winh: Ha Jehová ol onh kolanok, xchi winh.
Ha juntzanhxo nación maj koljilaj heb' yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
¿B'aj ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Amat yet' chonhab' Arfad? ¿B'ajtil ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Sefarvaim, Hena yet' Iva? ¿Tokwal ix kolchaj Samaria t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh Asiria onh tik yuj sdiosal?

¿Mach junok t'a skal juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh nación chi' ix yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to a Jehová ol yal skolanel Jerusalén tik? xchi winh yajal soldado yik Asiria chi'.
Palta tz'innhej xchi masanil heb' anima chi'. Manhxa mach ix tak'wi, yujto a winhaj rey Ezequías ix halani to malaj mach stak'wi.

Yuj chi' ix stzilchitanb'at spichul heb' winh oxwanh chi', yujto ix te tak sk'ol heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul winh yik kusk'olal, ix b'at lesalwok winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Ix schekanb'at winhaj Eliaquim winh, winhaj Sebna yet' pax heb' winh yajal heb' winh sacerdote. Ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yil winh schekab' Dios, haton winhaj Isaías yuninal winhaj Amoz.

Ix b'at yalan heb' winh tas syal winh rey: Ha tikne'ik ayonh och t'a yahelal, t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a k'ixwelal. Icha junok ix ix wan sb'o sk'ol yuj unin, manhxa jab'ok yip skani, icha wal chi' kaj tikne'ik.

Komonok wal ix yab' Jehová ko Diosal tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria ayik ix b'uchwaj winh t'a ko Diosal pitzan. Komonok tz'ak'jioch yahelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová, yuj tas ix yal chi'. Lesalwanh ku'uj mach onh ayonh to ek' tik, xchikot winhaj Ezequías, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Isaías tas ix yal heb' winh schekab' winhaj Ezequías chi',

ix schekanxib'at heb' winh winh yal t'a winh rey icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Manh ex xiw yuj tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi', te chuk tas ix yal winh t'ayin, max yal-laj in kolwaj yalan winh.
Ha in swala' to ol wak'och jun xiwk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ayik ol yab'an junok ab'ix winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', hata' ol wak' miljokcham winh, xchi Jehová, xchib'at winhaj Isaías chi'.

Ix yab'an winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria to manhxo ayok ek' winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a chonhab' Laquis. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winh, ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a chonhab' Libna, wan yak'an owal winh yet' jun chonhab' chi'.
Hata' ix yab' winh rey chi' yalji to a winhaj Tirhaca sreyal Etiopía wan skot yet' heb' soldado ul yak' owal yet' winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi'.
Ix yalankot winh icha tik: Ha a Diosal tz'alan t'ayach to manh ol ak'jokoch Jerusalén t'a yol in k'ab', palta manh ak' musansatil a b'a yuj tas syal a Diosal chi' t'ayach.
Tekan ix ab'i tas ix aj ko satanel juntzanhxo nación a onh sreyal onh Asiria tik, ¿tom ol yal a kolji yuj a Diosal chi' a na'ani?
¿Tokwal ix kolji heb' anima yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' in mam wicham? Haton heb' aj Gozán, heb' aj Harán, heb' aj Resef heb' aj Bet-edén kajan t'a Telasar, ix satjiel heb'.
¿B'ajtil ay winh sreyal chonhab' Hamat, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena yet' Iva? xchikot winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix scha'an jun carta winhaj rey Ezequías chi' b'aj tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj chi'. Ix yilan winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová, ix xuyanel jun carta chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ach ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ayach ek' t'a skal snanhal querubín, a achnhej Dios ach t'a yib'anh masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha ach ix a b'o satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an tas ix yalkot winhaj Senaquerib t'ayin. Ach Dios pitzan, ix te b'uchwaj winh t'ayach.
Wal yel tzijtum nación satnakxoel yuj heb' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
Ix snhusantz'a sdiosal heb', heb' winh. Yujto a juntzanh chi' manh diosoklaj, nab'a te', nab'a k'e'en b'ob'il yuj heb' anima, yuj chi' ix yal satanel heb' winh.

Ha tikne'ik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, kolonhel t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', yik syojtakejel masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to a achnhej Dios ach, malaj junokxo, xchi winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalankot winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ix wab' a lesal yuj tas syal winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swal yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Ach Senaquerib, a heb' ix kob'estak aj chonhab' Sion, malaj elk'och t'a yol sat heb' ix, tonhej ol ach stzetzej heb' ix. Ha heb' aj Jerusalén, ol b'at miknaj heb' ol ach sb'uchan heb'.
¿Mach jun ix a b'uchu' ix a xib'tani? ¿Mach jun b'aj cha'anh ix utej a jaj, ix ik'ancha'anh a b'a t'ay? Haton t'ayin a in sDiosal in Israel tik to a inxonhej ochi.

Ix a chek yal b'uchwal lolonel heb' winh a chekab' t'ayin Yajal in tik. Ix halan icha tik: Ix in k'e t'a jolomtak witz yet' jantak in carruaje, haton t'a jolomtak witz cha'anh t'a yol yik Líbano. Ix in ch'akanel te' k'ute' cha'anh ste'el yet' te' taj manh jantakok swach'il. Ix in k'enhejk'och t'a jolomtak witz cha'anh b'aj te k'ayum te te' wach' yilji.
Ha t'a ch'ok chonhab'il ix wak' joychaj ha' uk'b'ila', hata' ix wuk' ha'. Ha ix in ek' t'a yoltak ha ha' t'a Egipto, ix in tek'ankan tup ha', xa chi.

Palta, ¿tom malaj b'aj ix ab'i to a in ton Jehová in? Wu'uj tz'elk'och juntzanh tik. Atax t'a peka' ix in na'a to ol a k'ulej juntzanh tik. Ha tikne'ik jun, wan yelk'och wu'uj, yuj chi' syal a satanel juntzanh nación te ay yip ix k'ekan b'ulan sk'ajil u'uj.

Manhxalaj yip heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh nación chi', ix te xiw heb', ix k'ixwi heb'. Lajan ix aj heb' icha anh itaj ya'ax, mato icha anh ank'ultak sk'ib'k'e t'a yib'anhtak pat, kotakto anh stakjiel anh, icha chi' yaj heb' anima chi'.
Wojtak masanil tas tza k'ulej yet' tas nab'il u'uj tzach ek'i. Wojtakpaxi to te aykot owal t'ayin.

Toxo ix wab'i to aykot owal t'ayin, tzik'ancha'anh a b'a. Yuj chi' ol wak'och jun k'e'en argolla t'a a nhi' yet' jun freno t'a a ti', ol ach wak'an meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ix ach koti, xchi Jehová t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Isaías t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi': Ha jun tik yechel ol ch'oxjok heyila' yuj tastak toto ol ujok: Ol he wa ixim trigo munil syawej sb'a t'a jun ab'il tik yet' t'a junxo ab'il sjawi. Manhok exlaj ol yawej ixim. Haxo wal t'a yoxil ab'il jun, a exxo ol eyawej ixim he trigo chi', ol he jochank'e wa'an. Ol eyawejpax eyuwa, ol he loan sat.
Ha jaywanhokxo ex ol ex kan t'a Judá, lajan ol ex ajkan icha junok te te' sb'at sch'anhal yib' t'a yol lu'um syak'an sat.
Haxo t'a Jerusalén, ayto mach ol kan t'ay. Yet' pax t'a tzalan Sion, manh ol satel-laj anima smasanil. Ha jun tik, ol sk'ulej Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yujto te xajan ex yuj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Asiria icha tik: Manh ol ochlaj winh t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén, malaj wal junok sjul-lab' winh ol yak'lej sjulankoti. Manh ol jawoklaj winh yak' owal t'a Jerusalén tik, manh ol sb'ok'elaj stek'nub' winh t'a spatiktak smuro'al chonhab' tik.
Ha in Jehová in tik swala' to ha t'a b'e b'aj ix jawi winh, hanheja' ta' ol meltzajpax winh. Manh wal jab'ok ol yal yoch winh t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ha in ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wu'uj, yuj pax in b'inaji, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix ek' jun yángel Jehová smilcham 185 mil heb' soldado asirio t'a scampamento heb', yuj chi' chamnakxo heb' ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anel scampamento winhaj Senaquerib chi' ta', ix paxkan winh t'a Nínive.

Ha t'a jun k'u ayik ayoch winh ejmelal t'a sdiosal skuch Nisroc t'a yol stemplo, ix tekjicham winh yuj heb' winh yuninal ta', haton winhaj Adramelec yet' winhaj Sarezer. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atkan heb' winh elelal t'a yol yik Ararat, haxo junxo yuninal winh skuchan Esarhadón ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te ow jun ilya ix och t'a winhaj Ezequías, wanxo scham winh. Haxo winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, yuninal winhaj Amoz ix b'at ilan winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix yal Jehová to tzalkani tas ol ajkan masanil tas ay t'ayach, yujto ol ach chamnhej, manhxo ol ach b'oxok, xchi winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sutmajoch winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a sat pat, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, ix yalan winh:
Mamin Jehová, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a nakot yuj tas ix wutej ach wak'an serwil yet' in k'anab'ajan t'ayach t'a wal yel. Ix in k'ulej tas scha a k'o'ol, xchi winh. Ix ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo ix aji, ayik manto wal elk'och winhaj Isaías t'a snanhal yamak'il spat winh rey chi', ix lolonpax Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani:

Meltzajanh, b'at al t'a winhaj Ezequías yajal in chonhab': Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax winh a mam icham aj David: Toxo ix wab' a lesal, ix wil yel yal a sat ok'i. Ol wak' b'oxok a k'o'ol, haxo chab'ej syalxo a b'at t'a templo.

Olto wak' 15-okxo ab'il a k 'inal. Ol ach in kolnhej yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria. Ha in ol in tanhwej chonhab' tik, yuj sniwanil welk'ochi, yuj pax in ti' wak'nak t'a winh in chekab' aj David, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ix schekan winhaj Isaías b'ojok sat te' higo, ix ak'chajoch t'a sat jun yab'il chi', ix b'oxikan sk'o'ol winh yuj.

Ayik manto b'o jun remeyo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi' icha tik: --¿Tas junok yechel ol wila'' yik ol nachajel wu'uj to a Jehová ol ak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol, yik syal in b'at t'a stemplo t'a chab'ej chi'? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Isaías chi': --Ay jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová t'ayach yik wach' ol nachajel u'uj to ol elk'och tas ix yala'. Ha ach tzala' tato sb'ab'laj wewen t'a lajunhe' b'akhkiltak t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u, mato schael yich yemxi jun wewen chi' t'a spatik lajunheok b'akhkiltak chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ayik sb'at wewen chi' t'a yichanh, sekojtak, palta tato schaxiel yemxi lajunheok b'akhkiltak t'a spatik, a jun chi' ajaltak, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tewi winhaj Isaías chi' t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'anxi yik tz'elxi yich yemxita wewen chi' t'a lajunh b'akhkiltak chi' t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u yik winhaj Acaz.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winh sreyal Babilonia, haton winhaj Merodac-baladán yuninal winhaj Baladán, ix yab' winh to pena'ayaxnak winhaj Ezequías, yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' winh schekab' winh yik tzul yak'ankan jun carta heb' winh yet' junok silab' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ix chaji heb' winh chekab' chi' yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'. Masanil tas sik'an yuj winh, ix sch'ox winh t'a heb' winh: Haton k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, perfume yet' aceite te wach' yet' pax b'aj molanek' yamk'ab' yik owal yet' jantak tas molan yuj winh. Manhxa junokxo tas ay t'a spalacio winh yet' t'a yol smakb'en to maj sch'oxlaj t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Ezequías chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ix kot juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'? ¿Tas xchi heb' winh t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ix kot heb' winh t'a jun nación te najat, t'a Babilonia, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Isaías chi': --¿Tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol a palacio tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Ezequías chi': --Masanil tas ix yil heb' winh, manhxa jab'ok tas ayek' tik maj yil heb' winh, masanil ix in ch'ox t'a heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach:
Ol k'och wal sk'uhal, masanil tas ay t'a a palacio yet' masanil tas ix smolb'ejkan heb' a mam icham, ol ik'chajb'at smasanil t'a Babilonia, manhxa jab'ok tas ol kanok.
Yet' pax heb' inhtilal, ol ik'chajb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ol ik'chajel snholob' sk'e'en heb', ol ak'chajoch heb' yak'umalok serwil winh sreyal Babilonia chi', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi': --Ha jun lolonel ix al t'ayin yuj Jehová tik te wach', xchi winh. Ix yal winhaj Ezequías chi' icha chi', yujto ix sna' winh to ay junk'olal yakb'an pitzanto winh.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ezequías yet' tas niwan yelk'och ix sk'ulej winh, haton tas ix aj sb'o'an jun nhajab' winh yet' tas ix aj yik'ankot ha ha' winh t'a yol chonhab', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, a winhaj Manasés yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Manasés chi', 12 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 55 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Hepsiba sb'i ix snun winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha masanil chukal sb'eyb'alej juntzanh nación ix yik'el Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel, a ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ix schekan winh to sb'ojixik'e juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, juntzanh ix schek winhaj Ezequías mak'jipojok. Ix sb'oanxik'e altar yik Baal winh, ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun yechel Asera winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Acab sreyal Israel. Ix och winh ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'anal.
Ix sb'oanpaxk'e juntzanh altar winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton t'a jun lugar yalnak Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun templo t'a Jerusalén ol och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.
Ay juntzanhxo altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a chab' yamak'il stemplo Jehová, yik tz'och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh k'e'en k'anal.

Hanhejtona' ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il t'a junok sdiosal chi'. Ix sk'anb'an sb'a winh t'a heb' ajb'a'al, t'a heb' ajchum, t'a heb' naumel lolonel. Ix sk'anb'anpax sb'a winh t'a heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'paxoch jun te' yechel Asera winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton jun templo chi' yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj David yet' t'a winh yuninal haton winhaj Salomón icha tik: Ha t'a in templo t'a Jerusalén, jun chonhab' ix in sik'kanel t'a skal masanil chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Israel tik, a t'ay ol in kajnaj t'a junelnhej.

Tato ol sk'anab'ajej masanil in cheknab'il heb' eyetchonhab' yet' in kachnab'il yet' pax in k'ayb'ub'al in cheknak yal winh in chekab' aj Moisés t'a heb', manhxo ol wik'el heb' t'a sat jun lum lum wak'nak t'a he mam eyicham, xchi Jehová.

Palta maj scha yab' juntzanh chi' heb'. Ha wal winh rey chi' ix kuchb'an heb' t'a chukal chi'. Ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh juntzanh nación satb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a heb' schekab':

Ha winhaj Manasés chi', a tas te yajb'entak sk'ulej winh t'a wichanh, yelxo wal ek'b'al chukal sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh heb' amorreo, heb' ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Skuchb'an heb' yetchonhab' winh t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová sDiosal Israel swal icha tik: Ol wik'kot yahelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh Judá tik, ol te sat sk'ol heb' ol ab'anok.

Ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén tik icha ix wutej Samaria yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Ol wik'el masanil heb' anima kajan t'ay, lajan ol ajkan icha junok uk'ab' ayik slajwi sb'ikchaji nhojan tz'ajkani.
Haxo jaywanhokxo heb' in chonhab' tik, ol waktejkan heb', ol wak'kanoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, yik wach' ol ik'chajek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, stzuntzejnhejkot yowal in k'o'ol heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, xchi t'a heb' schekab'.
Ix te kuchb'aj wal heb' aj Judá yuj winhaj Manasés chi' t'a chukal t'a yichanh Jehová. Tzijtum pax heb' anima malaj smul ix smilcham winh, ix laj b'ey schik'il heb' smasanil t'a smakb'en Jerusalén.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manasés chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak smul winh ix ochi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza t'a sti' spalacio winh ix mukchaji. Haxo winhaj Amón yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Amón chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Mesulemet sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Haruz aj Jotba.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés smam winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej, ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel b'aj ochnak winh smam winh chi' ejmelal.
Icha chi' ix aj spatikanel Jehová Dios winh, haton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj scheknab'il Jehová winh.
Ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj heb' winh t'a yol spalacio.

Yuj chi', haxo heb' aj Judá ix milancham heb' winh ix milancham winh rey chi', haxo winhaj Josías yuninal winh ix yak'och heb' reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amón yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ayik ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza ix mukji winh.
Ha winhaj Josías wajxake' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jedida sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Adaías aj Boscat.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh, manh wal jab'ok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a sb'eyb'al winh smam yicham chi'.

Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal, ix schekanb'at winh stz'ib'um winh t'a stemplo Jehová, haton winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yixchikin winhaj Mesulam. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik:
--Ixik t'a winhaj Hilcías winh sat sacerdote, tzalan t'a winh to smolb'ej k'e'en tumin winh tz'ak'ji t'a stemplo Jehová, k'e'en scha heb' stanhwan puerta b'aj tz'och heb' anima,
syak'an k'e'en winh t'a heb' winh yajal yaj yilan sb'ochajxi templo chi' yik stupchaj heb' winh smunlaj t'ay,
haton heb' winh nhikum te' yet' heb' winh tz'ilan tas tz'aj sb'o munlajel chi' yet' heb' winh albañil. Smanchajpax te te' yet' k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il, yik sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Manh yowalilok sk'anchaj yumal k'e'en tumin chi' t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', yujto tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'o'ani, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Hilcías chi' t'a winhaj Safán to ix cheklaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan ley t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix yak'an ch'anh winh t'a winhaj Safán chi', ix yawtan ch'anh winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Safán chi' yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix smol k'e'en tumin ay t'a yol templo heb' winh a chekab', ix yak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yilan sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' ix yalanxi winh to ix ak'ji jun ch'anh u'um t'a winh yuj winhaj sacerdote Hilcías, yuj chi' ix yawtej ch'anh winh yab' winh rey chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey chi' tas syal t'a yol ch'anh, ix snhik'chitan spichul winh,

ix schekan winh awtaj winhaj Hilcías chi', winhaj Safán tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán chi', winhaj Acbor yuninal winhaj Micaías yet' winhaj Asaías schekab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixikek he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová wu'uj, yuj heb' chonhab', yuj pax masanil heb' aj Judá, tas syalelk'och ch'anh ley tik. Ay am kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a kib'anh, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' ko mam kicham tas syal ch'anh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj sacerdote Hilcías, winhaj Ahicam, winhaj Acbor, winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Asaías yil ix schekab' Dios, ix skuchan Hulda yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticva, yixchikin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi', a winh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj k'apak pichul t'a templo. Ha ix Hulda chi', ha t'a junxo makan yik Jerusalén toto b'onak, hata' kajan ix. Ayik ix lolonb'at heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Alek t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej tik t'ayin
to a in ol wak'kot junok yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a tik, icha yalan ch'anh ley ix yawtej winh sreyal Judá chi'.

Yujto ix in yaktejkan heb' anima tik, ix snhusan incienso heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ix stzuntzankot yowal in k'ol heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal heb' ix sb'o chi'. Yuj wal chi' ix kot wowal t'a jun lugar tik. Manhxo ol sikb'ilaj wowal chi', xchi Jehová.
Alek t'a winh rey chi', winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik tz'alan icha tik: Yujto ix awtej tas ayem t'a yol ch'anh u'um chi',

ix ak'anoch t'a a k'o'ol, yuj chi' ix al a b'a t'ayin, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach ok'k'e t'a wichanh. Yujto ix ab'pax tas ix wala' to ol satjokel a chonhab' tik, ol in katab'an heb' kajan t'ay, yuj chi' toxo ix wab' tas ix ala'. Swal t'ayach

to ix ach wak' niwank'olal, ol ach mukjok t'a junk'olal. Manhxo ol il-laj jun yahelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Ix paxta heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' yik tzul yalan heb' winh t'a winh tas ix b'at yab' heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtaj masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yik wach' smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' winh.

Ayik ix jawi heb' winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh, heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh schekab' Dios yet' masanil heb' komon anima, heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová. Hata' ix yal winh rey chi' to a ch'anh yumal strato Jehová ix chax t'a stemplo, tz'awtaj ch'anh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi'.

Ix och tek'tek' winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy, ix yak'an sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to ol sk'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il winh yet' k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, icha syal jun trato tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh u'um chi'. Hanheja' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh sat sacerdote aj Hilcías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote yet' t'a heb' winh stanhwan spuerta'il templo to syik'elta heb' winh masanil tastak ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton yamk'ab' sk'an heb' anima yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, t'a Asera yet' t'a k'e'en k'anal. Ix yik'el heb' winh t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén, ix snhusantz'a heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix lajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sta'anhil t'a Betel.

Ix yik'anel yopisio heb' winh sacerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh snhusantz'a incienso b'aj cha'anh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a stitak chonhab' Jerusalén, haton heb' winh ak'b'il yopisio yuj heb' winh rey ek'nak. Ix ik'chajpaxel heb' winh sacerdote snhusantz'a incienso t'a Baal, t'a k'u, t'a k'e'en uj, t'a k'e'en k'anal yet' t'a juntzanh niwak k'anal sb'eyek' t'a satcha'anh.

Ix yik'anpaxel jun yechel Asera winh rey chi', haton jun ayoch t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ankan heb' t'a stiel chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix nhuschajtz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix stenanchojok stanhil chi' winh, ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'aj mukan heb' komon anima.
Ix pojjipaxem juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh ix-winak yuj winh, haton b'ob'il t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Hata' sch'alwipax heb' ix ix sb'o'an k'apak mantiado yik Asera.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sacerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh ay t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yixtanb'at masanil altar winh t'a masanil lugar cha'anh t'a Geba masanto t'a Beerseba, haton b'aj snhustz'a incienso juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote. Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh, juntzanh ay t'a spuerta'il chonhab' skan t'a stojolal sk'exan mach tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', haton jun puerta yik winhaj Josué yajal t'a Jerusalén.

Ha heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal Leví ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, majxo k'ochlaj heb' winh t'a altar yik Jehová t'a Jerusalén, haxonhej swa'el heb' winh tz'ak'ji yuj heb' winh yetsacerdote'al chi'.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at jun lugar winh rey chi', jun skuchan Tofet t'a sch'olanil Ben-hinom b'aj snhusjitz'a heb' unin silab'il t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc, yik manhxa junok mach sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxel nok' chej winh, nok' ayoch yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá yik tz'och ejmelal t'a k'u. Ix snhusantz'a scarruaje nok' chej chi' winh. Ha juntzanh chi', ha t'a jun amak' t'a slak'anil b'aj tz'och anima t'a yol stemplo Jehová, hata' ay, t'a stz'ey scuarto jun winh ay yopisio skuchan Natán-melec.

Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh rey chi', juntzanh b'ob'ilkan yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá t'a spanhanil yib'anh scuartokan winhaj rey Acaz. Ay pax juntzanh altar b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Manasés t'a chab' yamak'il stemplo Jehová, ix smak'poj winh, ix syumankanb'at sk'ajil winh t'a yol ha' Cedrón.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at juntzanh lugar winh, juntzanh cha'anh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, t'a stojolal sur t'a tzalan Olivo, haton jun sb'onakkan winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel, haton Astarté sdiosal heb' aj Sidón, Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Masanil juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ix smak'anpaxpoj k'e'en k'e'en winh, k'e'en chajul yaj t'a heb' anima, ix ch'akchajpaxel te' yechel Asera. Ix saklemajb'at sb'akil chamnak ta' yuj winh.

Ix smak'paxpoj jun altar winh yet' templo t'a Betel, haton sb'onakkan winhaj rey Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Pokokxonhej ix aji, ix snhusantz'a yechel Dios Asera chi' winh.

Ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Josías chi', ix yilanb'at juntzanh yet'tal chamnak winh t'a jun tzalan, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'chajelta sb'akil chamnak ayoch t'a yo'ol chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yik tz'ixtaxb'ati. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan jun winh schekab' Jehová t'a peka'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Josías chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun yet'tal chamnak swilb'at chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' kajan t'a Betel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Haton b'aj mukan jun winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Judá, a winh aljinakkan yuj tas ix utej jun altar t'a Betel tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Aktejekkani, malaj junok mach syaman sb'akil chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' majxo yamjilaj sb'akil jun winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' sb'akil junxo winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Samaria.

Icha ix yutej winhaj Josías chi' t'a Betel chi', icha pax chi' ix yutej winh satanel juntzanh lugar cha'anh, juntzanh b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi' yuj heb' winh sreyal Israel, juntzanh stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar ix smilcham masanil heb' winh sacerdote winh, haton heb' winh yik juntzanh lugar cha'anh t'a Samaria chi'. Ix snhusantz'a sb'akil juntzanh chamnak winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josías t'a masanil heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kak'ekoch k'inh yik sko na'ankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto yik skik'ancha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, icha syalkan t'a yumal trato, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix och jun k'inh chi'. Yiktax ix lajwiek' stiempo'al heb' juez, heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, malaj junelok ix och jun k'inh icha jun chi' t'a stiempo'al heb' winh ix ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Israel.
Yik wal 18 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun k'inh chi' t'a Jerusalén, yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová.

Masanil heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak, heb' ajb'a'al yet' juntzanh yechel t'a yoltak pat, ix satjiel yuj winhaj Josías chi'. Masanil pax juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ay t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá ix satel winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yik sk'anab'ajan winh tas syalkan t'a yumal ley ix chax yuj winhaj sacerdote Hilcías t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Malaj junokxo rey ek'nakxo ix sk'ex spensar yik syak'anoch sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, t'a smasanil spensar yet' t'a smasanil yip, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Josías chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh tas alb'ilkan t'a ley Moisés. Manhxalaj pax junokxo rey icha chi' ix yutej sb'a.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh, palta yuj tas te chuk sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés, yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el Judá t'a wichanh, icha wutejnak Israel. Ol in patikejkanel Jerusalén, jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel wu'uj yet' jun templo tik, jun walnak yuj to a t'ay tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.

Ha t'a stiempo'al chi' ix kot winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado yik sb'at heb' t'a ha' niwan Éufrates, yik sb'at kolwaj winh yet' winh sreyal Asiria. Ix b'at winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a Meguido. Ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh t'a owal chi', ix miljicham winhaj Josías chi' yuj winh. Ix ak'jik'e sniwanil winh t'a yol carruaje yuj heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Meguido chi' masanto ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix ak'jikanoch sniwanil winh chi' t'a jun yet'tal b'ob'ilxo. Haxo heb' anima smasanil t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj Joacaz chi', 23 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Jerusalén. Oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix ak'jioch winh t'a preso yuj winhaj rey Necao t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat, yik wach' maxtzak yak' yajalil winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en tumin winhaj Necao chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi', 75 quintal k'e'en plata yet' oxe' arroba k'e'en oro.

Haxo winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' ix yak'och winhaj rey Necao chi' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ix sk'exan sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' winh, Joacim ix sb'iej winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Joacaz chi' winh t'a Egipto. Hata' ix cham winhaj Joacaz chi'.

Ix yak'an k'e'en oro winhaj Joacim chi' yet' k'e'en plata sk'an winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'och k'e'en winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en chi', junjun anima ix yak' k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata, icha tastak ay t'a junjun heb'. Icha chi' ix aj smolan k'e'en tumin winh ix kan t'a yib'anh chi'.
Ha winhaj Joacim chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Zebu sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Pedaías aj Ruma.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Joacim chi', ix kot winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan winhaj rey Joacim oxe' ab'il t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajoch winhaj Joacim chi' ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Palta ix ak'jikot heb' soldado caldeo yuj Jehová, heb' soldado sirio, heb' soldado moabita yet' heb' soldado amonita yik sjawi heb' elk'al t'a Judá yik syixtanb'at heb', icha ix aj yalan heb' schekab' Jehová.
Wal yel ix jawi jun tik t'a yib'anh Judá, yujto a Jehová ix halani yik syik'anel Judá t'a yichanh, yuj smul winhaj Manasés,
yuj pax schamel heb' anima malaj smul t'a Jerusalén ix cham yuj winh. Yuj chi' majxo yak'laj niwank'olal Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, a winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Majxo eltalaj winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado t'a yol smakb'en, yujto a winh sreyal Babilonia ix ik'anxiek' tas ik'b'ilek' yuj winh, skot t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto masanto t'a ha' Éufrates.
Ha winhaj Joaquín chi', 18 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Nehusta sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Elnatán aj Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix kot heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a Jerusalén, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik.
Wan yak'an owal heb', ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Joaquín sreyal Judá yet' ix snun, heb' winh yetyajalil winh yet' pax heb' winh schekab' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia ayik swajxakilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' reyal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' ik'chajelta masanil k'e'en tumin ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a yol spalacio winh sreyal Judá chi'. Ix smak'anpoj masanil yamk'ab' winh nab'a oro yik templo chi' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel. Ix elk'och jun tik icha ajnak yalankan Jehová.

Ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' heb' yajal, heb' soldado te jelan, heb' winh jelan sb'o'an tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'e'en. 10 mil heb' ix ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi' t'a smasanil. Manhxa mach ix kani, haxonhej heb' meb'a' ixto kani.

Ha winhaj rey Joaquín chi', ix snun winh, heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'och t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal masanil anima ix ik'chajb'at chi', ay 7 mil heb' winh soldado, ay pax mil heb' winh syal sb'o'an tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'e'en. Masanil heb' winh tik te tek'an heb' winh, te jelan pax heb' winh t'a owal.
Haxo winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Matanías yuk'tak smam winhaj Joaquín chi' reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix k'exji sb'i winh yuj winh, Sedequías ix sb'iejkan winh.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Joacim.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, ix yik'ankanel heb' t'a yichanh. Ix meltzajoch winhaj Sedequías ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ayik slajunhil k'uhal yoch slajunhil uj, ayik sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, ix jawi winhaj rey Nabucodonosor yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' winh t'a spatiktak, ix sb'oank'e stek'nub' heb' winh t'a spatiktak smuro'al.
Oyb'ilnhej jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb' winh, masanto ayik 11 ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías chi' reyal.
Ayik sb'alunhil k'uhal yoch schanhil uj t'a yol jun ab'il chi', ix em jun niwan wejel t'a yol chonhab' chi', manhxa jab'ok tas wach' swa'an heb' anima chi'.

Ix sb'o'an jun olan heb' winh soldado caldeo chi' t'a smuro'al chonhab' chi'. Wach'chom oyanoch heb' winh soldado t'a spatiktak chi', palta ix el winhaj rey Sedequías chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'ak'walil. Ix elk'och heb' winh t'a jun puerta t'a skal chab' muro t'a stz'ey b'aj ay yawb'en te' heb' winh rey, ix b'at heb' winh t'a jun b'e sk'och t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán.
Palta ix b'at heb' winh soldado caldeo chi' t'a spatik heb' winh, ix yamchaj winhaj Sedequías chi' yuj heb' winh t'a yak'likal Jericó. Ix saklemkanb'at heb' winh soldado winh.
Ix syaman winh rey chi' heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi' t'a Ribla, t'a yol yik Hamat. Hata' ix yal winh tas ol utaj winhaj Sedequías chi'.
T'a wal yichanh winhaj Sedequías chi' ix xikjicham heb' yuninal. Ix ik'chajk'eta yol sat winh, ix tzek'chaj winh t'a k'e'en cadena nab'a bronce, ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayik uke' k'uhalxo yoch yo'il uj t'a 19 ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix jawi winhaj Nabuzaradán yajalil heb' winh soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Jerusalén.
Ix snhusantz'a stemplo Jehová heb' winh yet' spalacio winh rey, masanil spat heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' masanil niwak pat.
Ix spojanem masanil smuro'al chonhab' Jerusalén chi' heb' winh.
Masanil heb' anima ayto kani, ix yik'b'at heb' winhaj Nabuzaradán chi', haton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' jelan sb'o'an tastak.
Haxonhej heb' te meb'a' ix yaktejkan winh, yik smunlaj heb' t'a awoj uwa yet' juntzanhxo tas tz'awchaji.

Masanil tastak nab'a bronce ay t'a yol templo ix smak'poj heb' winh soldado chi', haton chab' oy ayoch t'a sat templo chi', juntzanh sb'akhnub' yich kotak pila yet' jun niwan pila. Ix yik'anb'at k'e'en bronce chi' heb' winh t'a Babilonia.

Hanhejtona' b'aj tz'em k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, k'e'en pala, k'e'en ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil, k'e'en niwak cuchara yet' masanil tastak nab'a bronce sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová, ix yik'b'at heb' winh smasanil.
Ix yik'paxb'at juntzanh niwak waso heb' winh yet' k'e'en b'aj snhusji incienso yet' juntzanhxo tastak nab'a oro ma nab'a plata.

Manhxa yalb'anil jantak yalil k'e'en bronce ayoch t'a chab' niwak oy yik templo, t'a jun pila yik ha ha' yet' t'a juntzanh yich b'akhnub' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Salomón yik tz'ochkan t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha junjun oy chi', ek'b'al wajxake' metro ste'el. Ha sjolom oy chi' nab'a bronce, nanhal schab'il metro yaj k'e'i, haxo spatiktak sjolom oy chi', aypaxoch yelwanub' icha yilji te' granada. Ha juntzanh chi' nab'a bronce. Lajannhej yaj chab' oy chi'.
Ha winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' ix yaman winhaj Seraías sat sacerdote, winhaj Sofonías schab'il sacerdote yet' oxwanh heb' winh stanhwan sti' templo, ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal heb' anima ix kan t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yamchajpax jun winh sat yajal skuchb'an heb' winh soldado yet' pax owanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yet' jun winh tz'ib'um sb'o'an slista'il heb' winh soldado yet' pax 60-xo heb' winh niwak winak yaj t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil juntzanh heb' anima chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat. Hata' ix yal winh rey to scham heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jiel heb' aj Judá chi' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slu'um, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia.
Ix och winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam yixchikin winhaj Safán gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha winh ix kan yil jantakto anima ix kan t'a Judá chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' heb' winh yajal heb' winh soldado ixto kani, ix b'at heb' winh t'a Mizpa yet' heb' winh soldado chi', yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', haton winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías, winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea, winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Tanhumet aj Netofa yet' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal jun winh aj Maaca.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Gedalías chi' t'a heb' winh yet' t'a heb' winh soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: Manh ex xiw he kan t'a yalanh smandar heb' caldeo chi', kajnajanhek t'a yol nación tik, tzex och t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh sreyal Babilonia. Tato icha chi' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a yukil uj, ix jawi winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yixchikin winhaj Elisama, t'a yinhtilal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ay lajunhwanhxo heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh, ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh yet' heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' caldeo ayek' yet' winh t'a Mizpa chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima ix b'at elelal t'a Egipto yuj xiwelal t'a heb' caldeo chi'. Hata' ix b'at heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado.

Ayik 27 k'uhal yoch slajchawil ujal, ayik 37 ab'ilxo yik'chajb'at winhaj rey Joaquín t'a Babilonia, ix och winhaj Evil-merodac reyal t'a Babilonia chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi' ix sch'oxan swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Joaquín chi', ix yik'anelta winh winh t'a preso.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi' t'a winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch preso t'a Babilonia chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'exel spichul winhaj Joaquín sk'an t'a yol preso chi', ix wa winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a jantakto tiempo'al pitzan winh.
Ix ak'jinhej sgasto winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi' masanto ix cham winh.
